title.zh: 卷十四 本紀第十四: 宣宗上
title.raw: 卷十四 本紀第十四: 宣宗上 Volume 14 Annals 14: Xuanzong 1

sentences.zh: 宣宗繼天興統述道勤仁英武聖孝皇帝諱珣，本名吾睹補，顯宗長子，母曰昭華劉氏。

translations.literal: Emperor Xuanzong, styled Continuing Heaven's Rise and Unified Mandate, Expounding the Way, Diligent in Benevolence, Heroically Martial, Sagacious and Filial, taboo name Xun, original name Wudubu, was Xianzong's eldest son; his mother was Zhaohua Consort Liu.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xuanzong—styled Continuing Heaven's Rise and Unified Mandate, Expounding the Way, diligent in benevolence, heroically martial, sagacious and filial—with taboo name Xun and original name Wudubu, was Xianzong's eldest son; his mother was Zhaohua Consort Liu.

sentences.zh: 大定三年癸未歲生，世宗養于宮中。

translations.literal: He was born in the third year of Dading, the guiwei year; Shizong raised him in the palace.
translations.idiomatic: Born in Dading year 3, in the guiwei year, he was brought up in the palace by Shizong.

sentences.zh: 十八年，封溫國公，加特進。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he was enfeoffed Duke of Wenguo and granted extraordinary promotion.
translations.idiomatic: In year 18 he was made Duke of Wenguo and granted extraordinary promotion.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，賜今名。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year he was granted his present name.
translations.idiomatic: In year 26 he received his present taboo name.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，進封豐王，加開府儀同三司，累判兵、吏部，又判永定、彰德等軍。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year he was advanced to Prince of Feng, granted Kai Prefecture with ceremonial parity to the Three Excellencies, successively oversaw the Military and Civil Affairs ministries, and also oversaw Yongding, Zhangde, and other armies.
translations.idiomatic: In year 29 he was advanced to Prince of Feng, given Kai Prefecture with ceremonial parity to the Three Excellencies, served in turn over Military and Civil Affairs, and also directed Yongding, Zhangde, and other armies.

sentences.zh: 承安元年，進封翼王。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chengan he was advanced to Prince of Yi.
translations.idiomatic: In Chengan year 1 he was advanced to Prince of Yi.

sentences.zh: 泰和五年，改賜名從嘉。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Taihe he was given the name Congjia.
translations.idiomatic: In Taihe year 5 he was renamed Congjia.

sentences.zh: 八年，進封邢王，又封升王。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was advanced to Prince of Xing and also made Prince of Sheng.
translations.idiomatic: In year 8 he was advanced to Prince of Xing and also made Prince of Sheng.

sentences.zh: 所至著祥異。

translations.literal: Wherever he went, auspicious omens appeared.
translations.idiomatic: Wherever he went, strange blessings were seen.

sentences.zh: 九月甲辰，既皇帝位於大安殿。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on jiachen, he took the imperial throne in the Hall of Great Peace.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiachen, he ascended the throne in the Hall of Great Peace.

sentences.zh: 以紇石烈胡沙虎為太師、尚書令兼都元帥，封澤王。

translations.literal: Heishilie Hushahu was made Grand Preceptor, Director of the Secretariat, and concurrent commander-in-chief, and enfeoffed Prince of Ze.
translations.idiomatic: Heishilie Hushahu was appointed grand preceptor, director of the Secretariat, and commander-in-chief, and enfeoffed as Prince of Ze.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，諭尚書省，事有規畫者皆即規畫，悉依世宗所行行之。

translations.literal: On yisi he instructed the Secretariat: matters that need planning should be planned at once, all carried out according to Shizong's practice.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi he told the Secretariat: whatever needs planning, plan it now—follow everything Shizong did.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以駙馬雄名第賜胡沙虎。

translations.literal: On bingwu he bestowed on Hushahu a premier stud-prince residence.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu he granted Hushahu a residence of the foremost stud-prince rank.

sentences.zh: 丁未，諭宰臣曰：「朕即大位，群臣凡有所見，各直言勿隱。

translations.literal: On dingwei he told the councilors: "Having taken the great throne, if any of you ministers have views, speak frankly and do not conceal them.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei he addressed the councilors: "Now that I hold the throne, whatever any of you sees, speak plainly—hide nothing.

sentences.zh: 」臨奠于衛紹王第。

translations.literal: " He went in person to offer mourning at Prince Wei Shaowang's residence.
translations.idiomatic: " He went himself to mourn at Prince Wei Shaowang's house.

sentences.zh: 有司奏，舊禮當設坐哭。

translations.literal: The relevant offices reported that by old ritual seated mourning should be observed.
translations.idiomatic: The offices said that by the old rites he should mourn seated.

sentences.zh: 上命撤坐，伏哭盡哀。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered the seats removed and wept prostrate with full grief.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered the seats taken away and wept prone until grief was spent.

sentences.zh: 敕有司以禮改葬。

translations.literal: He ordered the offices to rebury according to ritual.
translations.idiomatic: He charged the offices to rebury the dead in proper form.

sentences.zh: 戊申，禦仁政殿視朝。

translations.literal: On wushen he held court audience from Renzheng Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen he received the court at Renzheng Hall.

sentences.zh: 賜胡沙虎坐，胡沙虎不辭。

translations.literal: He granted Hushahu a seat; Hushahu did not decline.
translations.idiomatic: He offered Hushahu a seat; Hushahu would not bow out.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，封皇子守禮為遂王，守純為濮王，皇女溫國公主。

translations.literal: On xinhai he enfeoffed the imperial son Shouli as Prince of Sui, Shouchun as Prince of Pu, and the imperial daughter as Princess of Wenguo.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai he made his son Shouli Prince of Sui, Shouchun Prince of Pu, and his daughter Princess of Wenguo.

sentences.zh: 夔王永升薨，上親臨奠。

translations.literal: Prince of Kui Yong Sheng died; the emperor personally attended the mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Kui Yong Sheng died; the emperor went in person to mourn him.

sentences.zh: 大元遣乙裏只來。

translations.literal: Great Yuan sent Yilibozhi.
translations.idiomatic: The Great Yuan sent Yilibozhi as envoy.

sentences.zh: 壬子，改元貞祐，大赦。

translations.literal: On renzi the era name was changed to Zhenyou and a grand amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi the reign title became Zhenyou and a great amnesty was declared.

sentences.zh: 恩賚中外臣民有差。

translations.literal: Favors and gifts were granted to officials and people inside and outside the court in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Rewards were handed out at every rank, inside the court and beyond.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，左諫議大夫張行信上章言崇節儉、廣聽納、明賞罰三事。

translations.literal: On bingchen Left Remonstrance Grandee Zhang Xingxin memorialized on three matters: honor frugality, broaden listening and acceptance, and clarify rewards and punishments.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Left Remonstrance Grandee Zhang Xingxin wrote on three things: hold to frugality, widen what the throne hears, and make rewards and punishments plain.

sentences.zh: 尚書右丞相徒單鎰進左丞相，封廣平郡王。

translations.literal: Right Director of the Secretariat Tushan Yi was advanced to left director and enfeoffed Prince of Guangping Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Right Director Tushan Yi was moved to the left directorship and enfeoffed as Prince of Guangping Commandery.

sentences.zh: 庚申，澤王胡沙虎等議廢故衛王為庶人，上曰：「朕徐思之，以諭卿等。

translations.literal: On gengshen Prince of Ze Hushahu and others debated deposing the former Prince of Wei to commoner status; the emperor said: "I will consider this at length and inform you.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Prince of Ze Hushahu and others urged that the former Prince of Wei be cast down to commoner; the emperor said: "I will think this over and tell you.

sentences.zh: 」壬戌，授胡虎中都路和魯忽土世襲猛安。

translations.literal: " On renxu Hushahu was granted the hereditary meng'an of Heluhutu in Zhongdu Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: " On renxu Hushahu received the Heluhutu hereditary meng'an in Zhongdu Circuit.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，詔諭六品以下官，有事可言者言之無隱。

translations.literal: On bingyin an edict told officials of sixth rank and below: those with matters to speak may speak without concealment.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin an edict reached officials of sixth rank and below: if you have something to say, say it—hide nothing.

sentences.zh: 閏月戊辰朔，拜日于仁政殿，自是每月吉為常。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, first day wuchen: the sun was worshipped at Renzheng Hall; thereafter this was fixed as a monthly practice on auspicious days.
translations.idiomatic: On the intercalary month's wuchen new moon the court worshipped the sun at Renzheng Hall; after that it became a monthly rite on lucky days.

sentences.zh: 授尚書左丞相徒單鎰中都路迭魯猛安。

translations.literal: Left Director Tushan Yi was granted the Dierru hereditary meng'an of Zhongdu Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Left Director Tushan Yi received the Dierru hereditary meng'an in Zhongdu Circuit.

sentences.zh: 庚午，上復舊名珣，詔所司，告天地廟社。

translations.literal: On gengwu the emperor restored his former taboo name Xun; an edict ordered the relevant offices to announce this to Heaven, Earth, temples, and altars.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu he took back his old taboo name Xun; the offices were told to proclaim it to Heaven, Earth, the temples, and the altars.

sentences.zh: 前所更名二字，自今不須回避。

translations.literal: The two characters of his former changed name need no longer be avoided from now on.
translations.idiomatic: The two characters of the name he had taken need no longer be taboo.

sentences.zh: 辛未，詔追尊皇妣為皇太后。

translations.literal: On xinwei an edict posthumously ennobled his imperial mother as empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei an edict raised his late mother to empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 是日，皇妃皇子至自彰德府。

translations.literal: That day the imperial consort and princes arrived from Zhangde Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: That same day the imperial consort and the princes came in from Zhangde Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 遣使使宋。

translations.literal: Envoys were sent to Song.
translations.idiomatic: He sent envoys to Song.

sentences.zh: 己卯，左諫議大夫張行信上疏請立皇太子。

translations.literal: On jimao Left Remonstrance Grandee Zhang Xingxin memorialized requesting establishment of a crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Zhang Xingxin, Left Remonstrance Grandee, asked that a crown prince be named.

sentences.zh: 甲申，立子守忠為皇太子。

translations.literal: On jiashen his son Shouzhong was established as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen his son Shouzhong was made crown prince.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，詔降故衛王為東海郡侯。

translations.literal: On bingxu an edict degraded the former Prince of Wei to Marquis of Donghai Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu an edict stripped the former Prince of Wei of his rank and made him Marquis of Donghai Commandery.

sentences.zh: 甲午，減定監察御史為十二員。

translations.literal: On jiawu the surveillance censors were fixed and reduced to twelve posts.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu the surveillance censorate was cut to twelve posts.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁酉朔，京師戒嚴。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, first day dingyou: the capital was placed under martial law.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, on the tenth month's dingyou new moon, the capital went on alert.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，大元乙裏只來。

translations.literal: On xinchou Great Yuan's Yilibozhi came.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Yilibozhi came again from the Great Yuan.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔應遷加官賞，諸色人與本朝人一體。

translations.literal: On yisi an edict said that for promotions and rewards due by merit, people of every category and native subjects of the dynasty were to be treated alike.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi an edict ruled that merit promotions and rewards should go alike to every sort of person and to native Jin subjects.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，敕有司，皇太子冊禮俟邊事息然後舉行。

translations.literal: On gengxu the offices were ordered that the crown prince's investiture ceremony should wait until border affairs had quieted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu he told the offices to hold the crown prince's investiture only after the frontier had settled.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，元帥右監軍朮虎高琪戰於城北，凡兩敗績而歸，就以兵殺胡沙虎於其第，持其首詣闕待罪。

translations.literal: On xinhai Marshalate Right Deputy Supervisor Tuhu Gaoqi fought north of the city, suffered two defeats and returned, then with troops killed Hushahu at his residence, brought his head to the palace, and awaited punishment.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Marshalate Right Deputy Supervisor Tuhu Gaoqi fought north of the city, lost twice, and came back; then he took soldiers to Hushahu's house, killed him, and brought the head to court to answer for his deed.

sentences.zh: 赦之，仍授左副元帥。

translations.literal: He was pardoned and still appointed Left Deputy Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: The court pardoned him and kept him as left deputy marshal.

sentences.zh: 壬子，殿前都點檢紇石烈特末也等補外。

translations.literal: On renzi Palace Front Chief Inspector Heishilie Temoye and others were assigned outside the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Palace Front Chief Inspector Heishilie Temoye and others were posted away from the capital.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，張行信上封事，言正刑賞、擇將帥，及鄯陽、石古乃之冤。

translations.literal: On jiayin Zhang Xingxin submitted a sealed memorial on correcting punishments and rewards, choosing generals, and the wrongs done to Shanyang and Shigu Nai.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Zhang Xingxin sent a sealed memorial: straighten punishments and rewards, choose the right commanders—and right the injustice done to Shanyang and Shigu Nai.

sentences.zh: 大元兵下涿州。

translations.literal: Great Yuan troops took Zhuo Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Great Yuan forces captured Zhuo Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 設京城鎮撫彈壓官。

translations.literal: Capital pacification and suppression commissioners were established.
translations.idiomatic: The court established capital pacification and suppression commissioners.

sentences.zh: 置招賢所。

translations.literal: An office to recruit the worthy was set up.
translations.idiomatic: An office to recruit men of talent was established.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，放宮女百三十人。

translations.literal: On guihai one hundred thirty palace women were released.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai one hundred thirty palace women were released.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊辰，夏人攻會州，徒單醜兒兵擊走之。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on wuchen, Western Xia attacked Huizhou; Commander Tudan Chou’er’s troops struck and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on wuchen, Western Xia attacked Huizhou; Commander Tudan Chou’er drove them off.

sentences.zh: 庚午，將乞和於大元，詔百官議於尚書省。

translations.literal: On gengwu the court was about to sue for peace with the Great Yuan and ordered the hundred officials to discuss it at the Ministry of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu the court prepared to sue for peace with the Great Yuan and ordered the hundred officials to deliberate at the Ministry of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 以橫海軍節度使承暉為尚書右丞，耿端義為參知政事。

translations.literal: Horizontal Sea Army commissioner Cheng Hui was made right vice director; Geng Duanyi was made participation councillor.
translations.idiomatic: Horizontal Sea Army Commissioner Cheng Hui was appointed right vice director; Geng Duanyi was appointed participation councillor.

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔贈死事裴滿福興及鄯陽、石古乃官。

translations.literal: On guiwei an edict posthumously granted offices to Peiman Fuxing, who had died in service, and to Zhiyang and Shigu Nai.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei an edict posthumously granted offices to Peiman Fuxing, who had died in service, and to Zhiyang and Shigu Nai.

sentences.zh: 大元兵徇觀州，刺史高守約死之。

translations.literal: Great Yuan troops overran Guan Prefecture; Prefect Gao Shouyue died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: Great Yuan forces overran Guan Prefecture; Prefect Gao Shouyue was killed.

sentences.zh: 又徇河間府、滄州。

translations.literal: They also overran Hejian prefecture and Cang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: They also overran Hejian prefecture and Cang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 乙未，定亡失告身文憑格。

translations.literal: On yiwei standards were set for lost appointment credentials and documents.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei regulations were fixed for lost appointment credentials and documents.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁酉朔，上御應天門，詔諭軍士，仍出銀以賜之。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, new moon on dingyou: the emperor took the throne hall at Yingtian Gate, addressed the troops, and gave out silver as reward.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the dingyou new moon, the emperor appeared at Yingtian Gate, addressed the troops, and distributed silver in reward.

sentences.zh: 平章政事徒單公弼進尚書右丞相，尚書右丞承暉進都元帥兼平章政事，左副元帥朮虎高琪進平章政事兼前職。

translations.literal: Participation Councillor Tudan Gongbi advanced to right chancellor of the Masters of Writing; Right Vice Director Cheng Hui advanced to grand marshal and participation councillor; Left Vice Marshal Shuhu Gaoqi advanced to participation councillor while retaining his former post.
translations.idiomatic: Participation Councillor Tudan Gongbi became right chancellor; Right Vice Director Cheng Hui became grand marshal and participation councillor; Left Vice Marshal Shuhu Gaoqi became participation councillor while keeping his former duties.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月丁卯朔，以邊事未息，詔免朝賀。

translations.literal: Year two, spring, first month, new moon on dingmao: because border affairs had not ceased, an edict excused the New Year court audience.
translations.idiomatic: In year two, on the dingmao new moon of the first spring month, border fighting still raging, he excused the New Year court audience.

sentences.zh: 辛未，大元兵徇彰德府，知府事黃摑九住死之。

translations.literal: On xinwei Great Yuan troops overran Zhangde prefecture; Acting Prefect Huang Boojiuzhu died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Great Yuan forces overran Zhangde prefecture; Acting Prefect Huang Boojiuzhu was killed.

sentences.zh: 宋人攻秦州，統軍使石抹仲溫擊卻之。

translations.literal: Song forces attacked Qin Prefecture; Army Commander Shimozhongwen struck and repelled them.
translations.idiomatic: Song attacked Qin Prefecture; Army Commander Shimozhongwen drove them back.

sentences.zh: 癸未，有司奏，請權止今年禘享朝獻原廟及皇太后冊禮，從之。

translations.literal: On guiwei the responsible offices memorialized asking to suspend for the year the di sacrifice, court offerings at the original temple, and the empress dowager’s investiture rites; approved.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei the responsible offices asked to suspend this year’s di sacrifice, offerings at the original temple, and the empress dowager’s investiture; the emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，征處士王澮，不至。

translations.literal: On yiyou the recluse Wang Huang was summoned; he did not come.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou the recluse Wang Huang was summoned; he did not come.

sentences.zh: 大元兵徇益都府。

translations.literal: Great Yuan troops overran Yidu prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Great Yuan forces overran Yidu prefecture.

sentences.zh: 命有司復議本朝德運。

translations.literal: The court ordered the responsible offices to reconsider the dynasty’s Virtue Phase.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered the responsible offices to reopen debate on the dynasty’s Virtue Phase.

sentences.zh: 乙未，大元兵徇懷州，沁南軍節度使宋扆死之。

translations.literal: On yiwei Great Yuan troops overran Huaizhou; Qinnan Army commissioner Song Yi died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Great Yuan forces overran Huaizhou; Qinnan Army Commissioner Song Yi was killed.

sentences.zh: 二月丙申朔。

translations.literal: Second month, new moon on bingchen.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the bingchen new moon.

sentences.zh: 壬子，大元乙裏只紮八來。

translations.literal: On renzi the Great Yuan envoy Yilibazha came.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi the Great Yuan envoy Yilibazha arrived.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，罷按察司。

translations.literal: On bingchen the surveillance commission was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen the surveillance commission was abolished.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，大元乙只復來。

translations.literal: On renxu the Great Yuan envoy Yili came again.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu the Great Yuan envoy Yili came again.

sentences.zh: 三月辛未，遣承暉詣大元請和。

translations.literal: Third month, on xinwei Cheng Hui was sent to the Great Yuan to sue for peace.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on xinwei, Cheng Hui was sent to the Great Yuan to sue for peace.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，赦國內。

translations.literal: On dingchou an amnesty was proclaimed within the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou an amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 癸未，京師大括粟。

translations.literal: On guiwei the capital carried out a great grain levy.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei the capital carried out a great grain levy.

sentences.zh: 甲申，大元乙裏只紮八來。

translations.literal: On jiashen the Great Yuan envoy Yilibazha came.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen the Great Yuan envoy Yilibazha arrived.

sentences.zh: 詔百官議於尚書省。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the hundred officials to discuss the matter at the Ministry of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered the hundred officials to deliberate at the Ministry of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以濮王守純為殿前都點檢兼侍衛親軍都指揮使，權都元帥府事。

translations.literal: On wuzi Prince Pu Shouchun was made palace-front commander-in-chief and commander of the personal guard, with acting charge of grand-marshalate affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Prince Pu Shouchun was made palace-front commander-in-chief and commander of the personal guard, acting in grand-marshalate affairs.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，奉衛紹王公主歸於大元太祖皇帝，是為公主皇后。

translations.literal: On gengyin the palace-guard Shaowang princess was given in marriage to the Great Yuan Founding Emperor; she became princess-empress.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin the palace-guard Shaowang princess was sent in marriage to Genghis Khan and became princess-empress.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，詔許諸人納粟買官。

translations.literal: On xinmao an edict allowed people to buy office by presenting grain.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao an edict allowed office to be purchased with grain.

sentences.zh: 京師戒嚴。

translations.literal: The capital was placed under martial law.
translations.idiomatic: The capital was placed under martial law.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，大元兵下嵐州，鎮西軍節使烏古論仲溫死之。

translations.literal: On renchen Great Yuan troops took Lan Prefecture; Western Pacification Army commissioner Wugulun Zhongwen died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Great Yuan forces took Lan Prefecture; Western Pacification Army Commissioner Wugulun Zhongwen was killed.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙未朔，以知大興府事胥鼎為尚書右丞。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, new moon on yimao: Acting Daxing prefect Xu Ding was made right vice director.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on the yimao new moon, Acting Daxing Prefect Xu Ding was appointed right vice director.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，奉遷昭聖皇后柩于新寺。

translations.literal: On wuxu the coffin of Empress Zhaosheng was moved to the new temple.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Empress Zhaosheng’s coffin was moved to the new temple.

sentences.zh: 時山東、河北諸郡失守，惟真定、清、沃、大名、東平、徐、邳、海數城僅存而已，河東州縣亦多殘毀。

translations.literal: At that time in Shandong and Hebei most prefectures had fallen; only Zhending, Qing, Wo, Daming, Dongping, Xu, Pi, and Hai—a few cities—barely survived, and Hedong prefectures and counties were also largely ravaged.
translations.idiomatic: By then most prefectures in Shandong and Hebei had fallen; only Zhending, Qing, Wo, Daming, Dongping, Xu, Pi, and Hai still held out, while Hedong prefectures and counties were largely ruined.

sentences.zh: 兵退，命僕散安貞等為諸路宣撫使，安集遺黎。

translations.literal: After the troops withdrew, Pusan Anzhen and others were appointed pacification commissioners for the various routes to settle the surviving populace.
translations.idiomatic: After the armies withdrew, Pusan Anzhen and others were made route pacification commissioners to settle survivors.

sentences.zh: 至是以大元允和議，大赦國內。

translations.literal: Thereupon, because the Great Yuan had accepted peace talks, a great amnesty was proclaimed within the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Once the Great Yuan accepted peace, a great amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，權厝昭聖皇后于新寺。

translations.literal: On guimao Empress Zhaosheng was provisionally interred at the new temple.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Empress Zhaosheng was provisionally interred at the new temple.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，詔有司具陣亡人子孫以備錄用。

translations.literal: On jiachen an edict ordered the responsible offices to register descendants of the fallen for future appointment.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen an edict ordered registers of descendants of the war dead for future appointment.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以都元帥承輝為右丞相。

translations.literal: On dingwei Grand Marshal Cheng Hui was made right chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Grand Marshal Cheng Hui was made right chancellor.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，左丞相、監修國史廣平郡主徒單鎰薨。

translations.literal: On gengxu Left Chancellor and Supervisor of the National History, Prince of Guangping Tudan Yi, died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Left Chancellor Tudan Yi, Prince of Guangping and supervisor of the national history, died.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，尚書省奏巡幸南京，詔從之。

translations.literal: On yimao the Ministry of the Masters of Writing memorialized proposing a tour to Nanjing; an edict approved it.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao the Ministry memorialized proposing a tour to Nanjing; the emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 己未，葬衛紹王。

translations.literal: On jiwei Prince Shao of Wei was buried.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Prince Shao of Wei was buried.

sentences.zh: 五月癸酉，承暉加金紫光祿大夫，封定國公。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on guiyou Cheng Hui was advanced to Jinzi Grand Master of the Palace and enfeoffed as Duke of Ding.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on guiyou, Cheng Hui was advanced to Jinzi Grand Master of the Palace and enfeoffed as Duke of Ding.

sentences.zh: 尚書左丞抹撚盡忠加崇進，封申國公。

translations.literal: Left Vice Director Monian Jinzhong was advanced to Honorary Advanced and enfeoffed as Duke of Shen.
translations.idiomatic: Left Vice Director Monian Jinzhong was advanced to Honorary Advanced and enfeoffed as Duke of Shen.

sentences.zh: 六月甲午朔，以按察轉運使高汝礪為參知政事。

translations.literal: Sixth month, new moon on jiawu: Surveillance and Transport Commissioner Gao Ruli was made participation councillor.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the jiawu new moon, Surveillance and Transport Commissioner Gao Ruli was appointed participation councillor.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，次內丘縣。

translations.literal: On guichou the emperor halted at Neiqiu county.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou the imperial progress halted at Neiqiu county.

sentences.zh: 大元乙裏只來。

translations.literal: The Great Yuan envoy Yili came.
translations.idiomatic: The Great Yuan envoy Yili arrived.

sentences.zh: 戊午，次彰德府，曲赦其境內。

translations.literal: On wuwu he halted at Zhangde Prefecture and granted a partial amnesty within its borders.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu he encamped at Zhangde Prefecture and granted a partial amnesty within its jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 庚申，次钜橋鎮。

translations.literal: On gengshen he halted at Juxiao town.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen he encamped at Juxiao town.

sentences.zh: 是日，南京行宮寶鎮閣災。

translations.literal: That day the Baozhen Pavilion of the Nanjing traveling palace burned.
translations.idiomatic: That day the Baozhen Pavilion at the Nanjing traveling palace burned.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，次宜村。

translations.literal: On renxu he halted at Yicun.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu he encamped at Yicun.

sentences.zh: 黃龍見西北。

translations.literal: A yellow dragon appeared in the northwest.
translations.idiomatic: A yellow dragon appeared in the northwest.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，車駕至南京。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month: the imperial carriage reached Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn the imperial procession reached Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 詔立元妃溫敦氏為皇后。

translations.literal: An edict installed Primary Consort of the Wendun clan as empress.
translations.idiomatic: An edict installed Primary Consort Wendun as empress.

sentences.zh: 八月甲午，以立後，百官上表稱賀。

translations.literal: Eighth month, jiawu: because the empress had been installed, the hundred officials submitted congratulatory memorials.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiawu, with the empress newly installed, the hundred officials submitted congratulatory memorials.

sentences.zh: 庚子，皇太子至自中都。

translations.literal: Gengzi: the crown prince arrived from the Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi the crown prince arrived from the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 丁未，夏人入邊，命移文責之。

translations.literal: Dingwei: Western Xia forces entered the border; he ordered a dispatch rebuking them.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Western Xia troops crossed the border; the court sent a dispatch rebuking them.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，罷經略司。

translations.literal: Jiayin: the Strategic Commission was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin the Strategic Commission was abolished.

sentences.zh: 應奉翰林文字完顏素蘭上書言事。

translations.literal: Hanlin Academician-in-Attendance Wanyan Sulan submitted a memorial on affairs of state.
translations.idiomatic: Hanlin Academician-in-Attendance Wanyan Sulan submitted a memorial on affairs of state.

sentences.zh: 九月壬戌朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, renxu new moon: there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the renxu new moon, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 皇孫生。

translations.literal: An imperial grandson was born.
translations.idiomatic: An imperial grandson was born.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，山東路報萊州之捷。

translations.literal: Guihai: the Shandong circuit reported victory at Laizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai the Shandong circuit reported victory at Laizhou.

sentences.zh: 辛未，立監察御史升黜格。

translations.literal: Xinwei: regulations were set for censor promotion and demotion.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei regulations were set for censor promotion and demotion.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，詔訓練軍士。

translations.literal: Gengchen: an edict ordered the training of troops.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen an edict ordered troops trained.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，諭宣徽院，正旦生辰不須進物。

translations.literal: Dinghai: he instructed the Palace Domestic Service that New Year’s Day and birthday gifts need not be presented.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai he told the Palace Domestic Service that New Year’s Day and birthday gifts need not be presented.

sentences.zh: 太白晝見於軫。

translations.literal: Venus appeared in daytime in the Zhen mansion.
translations.idiomatic: Venus appeared in daytime in the Zhen mansion.

sentences.zh: 戊子，禁軍官圍獵。

translations.literal: Wuzi: military officers were forbidden to hunt.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi military officers were forbidden to hunt.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲午，詔遣官市木波、西羌馬。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, jiawu: an edict dispatched officials to purchase horses of the Mubo and Xi Qiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jiawu, an edict dispatched officials to buy Mubo and Xi Qiang horses.

sentences.zh: 陝西軍戶戰死者給糧贍其家。

translations.literal: Soldiers of Shaanxi military households who died in battle were given grain to support their families.
translations.idiomatic: Families of Shaanxi military-household soldiers killed in battle were given grain support.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，大元兵徇順州，勸農使王晦死之。

translations.literal: Dingyou: Great Yuan forces advanced on Shunzhou; Agricultural Commissioner Wang Hui died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Great Yuan forces attacked Shunzhou; Agricultural Commissioner Wang Hui died defending it.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，左副元帥兼尚書左丞抹撚盡忠進平章政事。

translations.literal: Renyin: Left Deputy Marshal and Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Monian Jinzhong was advanced to Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Left Deputy Marshal and Left Vice Director Monian Jinzhong was promoted to grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 以御史中丞孛朮魯德裕為參知政事兼簽樞密院事。

translations.literal: Censor-in-Chief Bo Shulu Deyu was made Participation Councillor and concurrently signed for the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Censor-in-Chief Bo Shulu Deyu was appointed participation councillor and concurrently signed for the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 曲赦中都路。

translations.literal: A partial amnesty was granted in the Central Capital circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The Central Capital circuit received a partial amnesty.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，遣參知政事孛朮魯德裕行尚書省於大名府。

translations.literal: Yimao: Participation Councillor Bo Shulu Deyu was sent to conduct the Masters of Writing at Daming Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Participation Councillor Bo Shulu Deyu was sent to head the Masters of Writing at Daming Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，大元兵收成州。

translations.literal: Bingchen: Great Yuan forces took Chengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Great Yuan forces captured Chengzhou.

sentences.zh: 諭大名行省貶損用度。

translations.literal: The Daming branch secretariat was instructed to cut expenditures.
translations.idiomatic: The Daming branch secretariat was ordered to cut expenditures.

sentences.zh: 德州防禦使完顏醜奴伏誅。

translations.literal: Dezhou defense commissioner Wanyan Chounu was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Dezhou Defense Commissioner Wanyan Chounu was executed.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁卯，以御史大夫僕散端為尚書左丞相。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, dingmao: Censor-in-Chief Pusan Duan was made Left Chancellor of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on dingmao, Censor-in-Chief Pusan Duan was appointed left chancellor of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 曲赦山東路。

translations.literal: A partial amnesty was granted in the Shandong circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The Shandong circuit received a partial amnesty.

sentences.zh: 辛未，詔賜衛紹王家屬既稟。

translations.literal: Xinwei: an edict ordered stipends already allotted to the household of Weishaowang continued.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei an edict ordered continued payment of stipends already allotted to Weishaowang’s household.

sentences.zh: 詔有司答夏國牒。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the relevant offices to reply to Western Xia’s dispatch.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the relevant offices to reply to Western Xia’s dispatch.

sentences.zh: 丙子，許諸色人試武舉。

translations.literal: Bingzi: persons of all categories were permitted to take the military examinations.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi persons of all categories were permitted to take the military examinations.

sentences.zh: 蘭州譯人程陳僧叛，西結夏人為援。

translations.literal: Lanzhou interpreter Cheng Chenseng rebelled and in the west allied with Western Xia as support.
translations.idiomatic: Lanzhou interpreter Cheng Chenseng rebelled and sought aid from Western Xia in the west.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，熒惑犯房宿鉤鈐星。

translations.literal: Xinsi: Mars trespassed against the Hooked Clasp star in the Fang mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Mars trespassed against the Hooked Clasp in the Fang mansion.

sentences.zh: 癸未，曲赦遼東路。

translations.literal: Guiwei: a partial amnesty was granted in the Liaodong circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei the Liaodong circuit received a partial amnesty.

sentences.zh: 敕罷宣撫司輒擬官。

translations.literal: An edict forbade Pacification commissions to appoint offices on their own authority.
translations.idiomatic: An edict forbade pacification commissions to appoint offices on their own authority.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊戌，遣真定行元帥府事永錫等援中都。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, wuxu: Yongxi, acting for the Zhending branch marshalate, and others were sent to relieve the Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wuxu, Yongxi of the Zhending branch marshalate and others were dispatched to relieve the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 頒勸農詔。

translations.literal: An edict encouraging agriculture was promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: An edict encouraging agriculture was promulgated.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以和議既定，聽民南渡。

translations.literal: Dingwei: because the peace agreement was settled, the people were allowed to cross south.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, with the peace agreement settled, the people were allowed to cross south.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，登州刺史耿格伏誅，流其妻孥。

translations.literal: Yimao: Dengzhou prefect Geng Ge was executed and his wife and children banished.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Dengzhou Prefect Geng Ge was executed and his wife and children were banished.

sentences.zh: 大元兵徇懿州，節度使高閭山死之。

translations.literal: Great Yuan forces advanced on Yizhou; Military Commissioner Gao Lushan died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: Great Yuan forces attacked Yizhou; Military Commissioner Gao Lushan died defending it.

sentences.zh: 二月辛卯，環州刺烏古論延壽及斜卯毛良虎等敗夏人於州境，詔進官有差。

translations.literal: Second month, xinmao: Huanzhou Prefect Wugulun Yanshou and Xiemao Maolianghu and others defeated Western Xia forces within the prefecture; an edict ordered differentiated promotions.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on xinmao, Huanzhou Prefect Wugulun Yanshou, Xiemao Maolianghu, and others routed Western Xia troops in the prefecture; the court ordered promotions according to merit.

sentences.zh: 大元乙裏只來。

translations.literal: The Great Yuan envoy Jebe came.
translations.idiomatic: The Great Yuan envoy Jebe arrived.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，上臨奠皇太子殯所。

translations.literal: Renchen: the emperor personally attended mourning at the crown prince’s bier.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen the emperor personally attended mourning at the crown prince’s bier.

sentences.zh: 有司奏辰日不哭，上曰：「父子至親，何可拘忌！

translations.literal: The relevant offices reported that on chen days one should not weep. The emperor said: "Father and son are the closest of kin—how can one be bound by taboo!
translations.idiomatic: The relevant offices reported that mourning should cease on chen days. The emperor said, "Father and son are the closest of kin—how can one be bound by taboo!

sentences.zh: 」命御史中丞李英、元帥左都監烏古論慶壽領兵護餉中都，付以空名宣敕，許視功遷敘，逗撓者治以軍律。

translations.literal: " He ordered Censor-in-Chief Li Ying and Left Chief Inspector of the Marshalate Wugulun Qingshou to lead troops escorting provisions to the Central Capital, granting blank commission edicts and permitting promotion according to merit, with delayers punished under military law.
translations.idiomatic: " He ordered Censor-in-Chief Li Ying and Left Chief Inspector of the Marshalate Wugulun Qingshou to lead troops escorting grain to the Central Capital, with blank commission edicts and promotion by merit, while dawdlers would face military law.

sentences.zh: 乙未，改甯邊州隸嵐州。

translations.literal: Yiwei: Ningbian Prefecture was placed under Lan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Ningbian Prefecture was placed under Lan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔諸色人遷官並視女直人，有司妄生分別，以違制論，從戶部郎中奧屯阿虎請也。

translations.literal: On dingyou an edict ordered that promotions for people of all ethnic categories be treated the same as for Jurchen; if officials arbitrarily made distinctions, it was to be prosecuted as violation of statute — following the request of Ministry of Revenue bureau director Aotun Ahu.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou an edict ruled that officials of every ethnic category were to be promoted on the same terms as Jurchen; arbitrary distinctions by the bureaucracy would be punished as breach of statute, upon the request of Ministry of Revenue bureau director Aotun Ahu.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，敕宰臣饋乙裏只酒饌。

translations.literal: On xinchou the emperor ordered the chief ministers to present Yili Zhi with wine and food.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou the emperor ordered the chief ministers to send Yili Zhi wine and a feast.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，頒獎諭官吏軍民詔，曲赦，招撫北京作亂者。

translations.literal: On renyin an edict of reward and instruction to officials, soldiers, and people was issued; a partial amnesty was granted; rebels in Beijing were to be won over.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin the court issued an edict of reward and exhortation to officials, troops, and the people, granted a partial amnesty, and ordered pacification of rebels in the Beijing circuit.

sentences.zh: 丙午，尚書省以南遷後，吏部秋冬置選南京，春夏置選中都，赴調者不便，請並選于南京。

translations.literal: On bingwu the Secretariat reported that after the southward move, the Ministry of Personnel held autumn and winter selections at Nanjing and spring and summer selections at the Central Capital, which was inconvenient for those coming to take up posts; it requested that all selections be held at Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu the Secretariat reported that since the court had moved south, the Ministry of Personnel held autumn and winter examinations at Nanjing but spring and summer ones at the Central Capital, a hardship for appointees; it asked that all selections be held at Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 武清縣巡檢梁佐、柳口巡檢李咬住以誅颭賊張暉、劉永昌等功進官有差，皆賜姓完顏。

translations.literal: Wuqing county inspector Liang Zuo and Liukou inspector Li Yaozhu, for merit in executing the bandit chiefs Zhang Hui and Liu Yongchang and others, were promoted in differing grades; all were granted the surname Wanyan.
translations.idiomatic: For executing the bandit chiefs Zhang Hui, Liu Yongchang, and others, Wuqing Inspector Liang Zuo and Liukou Inspector Li Yaozhu were promoted in differing grades and all were granted the surname Wanyan.

sentences.zh: 丁未，山東宣撫使僕散安貞遣提控僕散留家等破賊楊安兒步騎三萬，殲其眾，降偽頭目三百餘人、脅從民三萬餘戶。

translations.literal: On dingwei Shandong pacification commissioner Pusan Anzhen sent control officer Pusan Liujia and others to defeat the bandit Yang An'er's thirty thousand infantry and cavalry, annihilated his force, and received the surrender of more than three hundred false chieftains and more than thirty thousand coerced households.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Shandong Pacification Commissioner Pusan Anzhen sent Control Officer Pusan Liujia and others to rout the bandit Yang An'er's thirty thousand foot and horse, destroyed his host, and accepted the surrender of more than three hundred pretender leaders and over thirty thousand coerced households.

sentences.zh: 戊申，減沿邊州府官資考有差。

translations.literal: On wushen the salary and tenure standards for frontier prefectures and districts were reduced in differing degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen salary and tenure requirements for frontier prefectures and districts were lowered by graded amounts.

sentences.zh: 壬子，立保城無虞及捕獲奸叛遷賞格。

translations.literal: On renzi standards were set for rewards and promotion for keeping cities secure without incident and for capturing traitors and rebels.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi the court established reward and promotion standards for cities kept secure without alarm and for the capture of traitors and rebels.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，敕奏急事不拘假日。

translations.literal: On yimao the emperor ordered that urgent memorials be received regardless of holidays.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao the emperor ordered that urgent memorials be accepted even on holidays.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，日初出赤如血，欲沒復然。

translations.literal: On dingsi at the sun's first rising it was red as blood; as it was about to set it was again the same.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi at sunrise the sun was red as blood, and at the moment of setting it appeared so again.

sentences.zh: 戊午，隆德殿鴟尾壞。

translations.literal: On wuwu the roof ornaments of Longde Hall broke.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu the roof ornaments of Longde Hall broke.

sentences.zh: 三月壬戌，詔河北州縣官，令文武五品以上辟舉，不聽以它事差占，仍勒終任。

translations.literal: Third month, on renxu: an edict ordered that Hebei prefectural and district officials be nominated by civil and military officials of the fifth rank and above; they were not to be diverted by other assignments, and were still bound to complete their full terms.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on renxu, an edict ordered that Hebei prefectural and district officials be nominated by civil and military officers of the fifth rank and above, forbidden other assignments that would pull them away, and required to serve out their full terms.

sentences.zh: 有勞績者但升遙領之職，應降罰者亦止本處居住。

translations.literal: Those with merit were only to be raised to titular concurrent posts; those who should be demoted or punished were also only to remain resident in their original posts.
translations.idiomatic: Meritorious men were only to be advanced to titular concurrent posts; those due for demotion or punishment were likewise kept in their original posts.

sentences.zh: 時河北殘毀，吏治多苟且以求代易，故著是令。

translations.literal: At the time Hebei was ravaged and ruined; official administration was mostly perfunctory in hope of rotation — hence this order was issued.
translations.idiomatic: Hebei was then wasted and ruined, and local administration was mostly slipshod in hope of reassignment — hence this order.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔百官各陳防邊利害，封章以聞。

translations.literal: On guihai an edict ordered all officials to set forth the advantages and harms of frontier defense, submitting sealed memorials.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai an edict called on every official to state the gains and losses of frontier defense in sealed memorials.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，敕河東、河北、大名長貳官訓練隨處義兵，鄰境有警，責其救援。

translations.literal: On bingyin the chief and vice officials of Hedong, Hebei, and Daming were ordered to train local militia wherever they were; if a neighboring circuit had an alarm, they were charged to rescue.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin the chief and vice officials of Hedong, Hebei, and Daming were ordered to drill local militia in each place and, when a neighboring circuit raised an alarm, to answer with relief.

sentences.zh: 降人自拔歸國者遷職，仍列其姓名，以招諭來者。

translations.literal: Surrendered men who came back to the state of their own accord were promoted in office, and their names were still listed to win over those yet to come.
translations.idiomatic: Defectors who returned to the dynasty of their own accord were promoted, and their names were published besides to encourage others.

sentences.zh: 沿河州縣官罷軟不勝職任者汰去，令五品已上官公舉，仍許今季到部人內先擇能者量緩急易之。

translations.literal: Officials of prefectures and districts along the river who were weak and unfit for their duties were removed; officials of the fifth rank and above were to nominate replacements publicly, and among those due at the ministry this season the able were first to be chosen and exchanged according to urgency.
translations.idiomatic: Incompetent officials along the Yellow River were dismissed; fifth-rank officers and above were to nominate successors openly, and among appointees due at the ministry that season the able were to be chosen first and posted according to urgency.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，安武軍節度使張行信上書言急務四事。

translations.literal: On dingmao Anwu Army military governor Zhang Xingxin submitted a memorial on four urgent matters.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Anwu Army Military Governor Zhang Xingxin memorialized on four urgent matters.

sentences.zh: 庚午，諭遼東宣撫使蒲鮮萬奴選精銳屯沈州、廣寧，以俟進止。

translations.literal: On gengwu the Liaodong pacification commissioner Puxian Wannu was instructed to choose crack troops and encamp them at Shenzhou and Guangning, awaiting further orders.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Liaodong Pacification Commissioner Puxian Wannu was told to select elite troops and station them at Shenzhou and Guangning pending orders.

sentences.zh: 壬申，長春節，宋遣使來賀。

translations.literal: On renshen, Longevity Festival: Song sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, the Longevity Festival, Song sent envoys with congratulations.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，諭尚書省，歲旱，議弛諸處碾磑，以其水溉民田。

translations.literal: On wuyin the Secretariat was instructed that, because of drought that year, it should consider relaxing the ban on water mills everywhere and using their water to irrigate the people's fields.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin the Secretariat was told that, with drought that year, it should consider lifting bans on water mills so their flow could irrigate civilian fields.

sentences.zh: 己卯，雨。

translations.literal: On jimao it rained.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao it rained.

sentences.zh: 自去冬不雨雪，至是始雨。

translations.literal: From the previous winter there had been no rain or snow; only now did rain fall.
translations.idiomatic: Since the previous winter there had been neither rain nor snow; only now did rain come.

sentences.zh: 勸農使李革言：「河北州縣官吏多求河南差占以避難，宜發元任領戍兵者。

translations.literal: Agriculture encouragement commissioner Li Ge said: "Hebei prefectural and district officials mostly seek assignments in Henan to avoid hardship; those who originally held posts leading garrison troops should be sent out.
translations.idiomatic: Agriculture Encouragement Commissioner Li Ge said, "Officials of Hebei prefectures and districts mostly seek Henan assignments to escape hardship; those who originally held posts commanding garrison troops should be sent back.

sentences.zh: 不可離則別注以往。

translations.literal: If they cannot leave, then note it separately and send them when possible.
translations.idiomatic: If they cannot be spared, register the fact and dispatch them when they can go."

sentences.zh: 」庚辰，御史臺言：「在京軍官及委差官芻糧券例悉同征行，乞減其給。

translations.literal: On gengchen the Censorate said: "Officers in the capital and commissioned officials receive fodder-and-grain ration tickets on the same scale as on campaign; we ask that the issue be reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen the Censorate said, "Capital officers and commissioned officials draw fodder-and-grain tickets at full campaign rates; we ask that the allowance be cut.

sentences.zh: 樞密院委差有俸有吏，非征行不必給。

translations.literal: Commissioned officials of the Bureau of Military Affairs who have salaries and clerks need not receive them when not on campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Bureau of Military Affairs commissioners who already have salaries and clerks need not receive them when not on campaign."

sentences.zh: 」皆從之。

translations.literal: All were approved.
translations.idiomatic: All were approved.

sentences.zh: 敕尚書省，入粟補官者毋括其戶為軍。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered the Secretariat that those who bought office by contributing grain were not to have their households registered as soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered the Secretariat not to register as soldiers the households of men who bought office by contributing grain.

sentences.zh: 有司議賞軍功，毋有所沮格。

translations.literal: The responsible offices deliberated on rewarding military merit without obstruction.
translations.idiomatic: The responsible offices were to deliberate on rewarding military merit without obstruction.

sentences.zh: 壬午，山東宣撫司報大沫堌之捷，夾谷石裏哥及沒烈擒賊渠劉二祖等斬之，前後殆賊萬計。

translations.literal: On renwu the Shandong pacification office reported victory at Damo Fortress: Jiagu Shilige and Molie captured and beheaded the bandit chieftain Liu Erzu and others; in all nearly ten thousand bandits were taken before and after.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu the Shandong Pacification Office reported victory at Damo Fortress: Jiagu Shilige and Molie captured and beheaded the bandit chieftain Liu Erzu and others, and in all nearly ten thousand rebels were killed before and after.

sentences.zh: 西京軍民變，遣官撫諭之。

translations.literal: Soldiers and civilians of the Western Capital mutinied; officials were sent to comfort and instruct them.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers and civilians of the Western Capital rose in mutiny; officials were sent to reassure them.

sentences.zh: 己丑，禁州縣置刃於杖以決罪人。

translations.literal: On jichou the use of blades fitted to staves in prefectures and districts to punish criminals was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou prefectures and districts were forbidden to fit blades to staves when punishing criminals.

sentences.zh: 前年，京兆治中李友直私逃華州，結同知防禦使馮朝、河州防禦判官郝遵甫、平涼府同知致仕楊庭秀、水洛縣主簿宿徽等團集州民，號「忠義扈駕都統府」，相扌延為亂，殺其防禦判官完顏八斤及城中女直人，以書約都統楊圭，為府兵所得。

translations.literal: The year before, Jingzhao assistant prefect Li Youzhi fled secretly to Huazhou, joined Vice Commissioner for Defense Feng Chao, Hedong defense judge Hao Zunfu, retired Pingliang vice prefect Yang Tingxiu, Shuiluo county registrar Su Hui, and others to gather the people of the prefecture, styled themselves the "Loyal Righteous Escort-of-the-Throne Commandery," fomented rebellion together, killed their defense judge Wanyan Bajin and Jurchen within the city, and by letter arranged with commander Yang Gui — the letter was obtained by prefectural troops.
translations.idiomatic: The year before, Jingzhao Assistant Prefect Li Youzhi had fled secretly to Huazhou, joined Vice Commissioner for Defense Feng Chao, Hedong Defense Judge Hao Zunfu, retired Pingliang Vice Prefect Yang Tingxiu, Shuiluo County Registrar Su Hui, and others to rally the prefectural populace under the name "Loyal Righteous Escort-of-the-Throne Commandery," fomented rebellion together, killed Defense Judge Wanyan Bajin and the Jurchen in the city, and wrote to Commander Yang Gui — the letter was seized by prefectural troops.

sentences.zh: 圭諱之，請自效，誘友直等執之，麾所招千餘人納仗，坑諸城下。

translations.literal: Gui concealed it and asked to prove his loyalty; he lured Youzhi and the others into capture, ordered the more than a thousand men he had recruited to lay down their weapons, and had them buried in pits below the wall.
translations.idiomatic: Gui kept silent and offered to redeem himself; he lured Youzhi and the rest into capture, ordered the thousand-odd men he had raised to surrender their arms, and had them buried in pits below the wall.

sentences.zh: 時京師道路隔絕，安撫司以便宜族友直等，至是以狀聞。

translations.literal: At the time roads to the capital were cut off; the pacification office executed Youzhi and the others on its own authority — only now was the report received.
translations.idiomatic: With roads to the capital cut off, the pacification office had executed Youzhi and the others on its own authority; only now did word reach the court.

sentences.zh: 乃贈八斤及被害官軍十餘人各一官，賻錢三百貫。

translations.literal: Thereupon Bajin and more than ten officials and soldiers who had been killed were each granted one rank posthumously and three hundred strings of cash for funeral expenses.
translations.idiomatic: Bajin and more than ten slain officials and soldiers were then each granted one posthumous rank and three hundred strings of cash for burial.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸巳，河東宣撫使胥鼎言利害十三事。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on guisi: Hedong pacification commissioner Xu Ding set forth thirteen items of advantage and harm.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on guisi, Hedong Pacification Commissioner Xu Ding memorialized thirteen items of policy.

sentences.zh: 長勝軍都統楊圭伏誅。

translations.literal: Changsheng Army commander Yang Gui was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Changsheng Army Commander Yang Gui was executed.

sentences.zh: 丙申，河南路蝗，遣官分捕。

translations.literal: On bingshen locusts struck the Henan circuit; officials were sent to hunt them in separate groups.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen locusts struck Henan; officials were sent out in groups to destroy them.

sentences.zh: 上諭宰臣曰：「朕在潛邸，聞捕蝗者止及道傍，使者不見處即不加意，當以此意戒之。

translations.literal: The emperor told the chief ministers: "When I was heir apparent I heard that locust hunters stopped only at the roadside — where envoys did not look they paid no heed. Take this as a warning to them."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told the chief ministers, "In my days as heir apparent I heard that locust hunters worked only along the roads and ignored whatever lay out of the envoys' sight. Let that be your warning to them."

sentences.zh: 」權參知政事德升言：「舊制夏至後免朝，四日一奏事。

translations.literal: Acting Participation Councillor Desheng said: "By old rule court attendance was waived after the summer solstice, with memorials heard once every four days."
translations.idiomatic: Acting Participation Councillor Desheng said, "By old rule court was not held after the summer solstice, and memorials were heard only once every four days."

sentences.zh: 」上曰：「此在平時可耳。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "That may do in normal times."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "That may do in normal times."

sentences.zh: 方今多故，勿謂朕勞，遂雲當免，但使國事無廢則善矣。

translations.literal: Now with many emergencies, do not suppose I am weary and therefore say it should be waived — only see that state affairs are not neglected, and that will be well enough."
translations.idiomatic: But now there are many emergencies; do not think me weary and therefore say court may be waived — only let state affairs not be neglected, and that will be enough."

sentences.zh: 」己亥，曲赦山東路。

translations.literal: On jihai a partial amnesty was granted for the Shandong circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai a partial amnesty was granted for Shandong.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，籍赴選臨當官為軍。

translations.literal: On guimao those coming to selection who were about to take office were registered as soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao candidates coming to examination who were on the verge of appointment were registered as soldiers.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，罷都南行尚書六部。

translations.literal: On yisi the Southern Capital traveling Six Ministries of the Secretariat were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi the traveling Six Ministries of the Secretariat at the Southern Capital were abolished.

sentences.zh: 侯摯言九事。

translations.literal: Hou Zhi set forth nine items.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Zhi memorialized nine items.

sentences.zh: 曲赦蒲察七斤脅從之黨，募能殺獲七斤者，以其官官之。

translations.literal: A targeted partial amnesty was granted to those coerced into following Pucha Qijin; whoever could kill or capture Qijin would receive his office.
translations.idiomatic: The court granted a targeted partial amnesty to Pucha Qijin’s coerced followers and offered Qijin’s office to anyone who killed or captured him.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以調度不給，凡隨朝六品以下官及承應人，罷其從己人力輸傭錢。

translations.literal: On bingwu, because supplies could not meet demand, for all officials at court of the sixth rank and below and for attendants, the corvée payment for personal servants attached to them was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, with the treasury unable to keep pace, officials at court of the sixth rank and below and all attendants were stripped of corvée payments for personal servants in their employ.

sentences.zh: 經兵州、府其吏減半，司、縣吏減三之一。

translations.literal: In war-affected prefectures and districts the clerical staff was cut by half; in subprefectures and counties by one-third.
translations.idiomatic: War-ravaged prefectures and districts halved their clerical staffs; subprefectures and counties cut theirs by one-third.

sentences.zh: 其餘除開封府、南京轉運司外，例減三之一。

translations.literal: Elsewhere, apart from Kaifeng Prefecture and the Nanjing Transport Commission, the rule was a reduction of one-third.
translations.idiomatic: Everywhere else, except Kaifeng Prefecture and the Nanjing Transport Commission, staffs were cut by one-third across the board.

sentences.zh: 有祿官吏被差不出本境並罷給券，出境者以其半給之。

translations.literal: Salaried officials on assignment who did not leave their circuit were also denied travel ration vouchers; those leaving the circuit received half.
translations.idiomatic: Salaried officials detailed within their home circuit no longer received travel ration vouchers; those sent beyond it received half the usual allowance.

sentences.zh: 修內司軍夫亦減其半。

translations.literal: Military laborers of the Palace Construction Directorate were likewise reduced by half.
translations.idiomatic: Military corvée laborers of the Palace Construction Directorate were likewise cut by half.

sentences.zh: 丁未，故皇太子啟菆，賜諡曰莊獻，戊申，權葬迎朔門外。

translations.literal: On dingwei encoffining began for the late crown prince; he was given the posthumous title Zhuangxian. On wushen he was provisionally buried outside Yingshuo Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei the late crown prince’s encoffining rites began and he received the posthumous title Zhuangxian. On wushen he was provisionally buried outside Yingshuo Gate.

sentences.zh: 詔自今策論詞賦進士，第一甲第一人特遷奉直大夫，第二人以下，經義第一人並儒林郎，第二甲以下征事郎，同進士從仕郎，經童將仕郎。

translations.literal: An edict ruled that from now on, for jinshi in the policy-essay and rhapsody track, the first-place man of the first class was specially promoted to Direct Upholding Grand Master; from the second man down, the first in classic exegesis together with Gentleman of the Confucian Grove, those of the second class and below to Gentleman for Administrative Service, associate jinshi to Gentleman for Attendant Service, and Classics Youth graduates to Gentleman for Initial Service.
translations.idiomatic: An edict fixed civil-examination promotions: in the policy-essay and rhapsody track the top first-class graduate was raised to Direct Upholding Grand Master; lower first-class places and the classic-exegesis leader to Gentleman of the Confucian Grove; second class and below to Gentleman for Administrative Service; associate jinshi to Gentleman for Attendant Service; and Classics Youth graduates to Gentleman for Initial Service.

sentences.zh: 壬子，芮國公從厚薨。

translations.literal: On renzi Prince Rui Conghou died.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Prince Rui Conghou died.

sentences.zh: 詔遣使同山西宣撫司選其民勇健者為軍。

translations.literal: An edict ordered envoys, together with the Shanxi Pacification Commission, to select the sturdiest men among the people for the army.
translations.idiomatic: An edict sent envoys with the Shanxi Pacification Commission to enroll the sturdiest local men as soldiers.

sentences.zh: 論有司，勿拒河北避兵之民，所至加存恤。

translations.literal: Officials were instructed not to turn away Hebei people fleeing the war and to give added relief wherever they arrived.
translations.idiomatic: Officials were told not to reject Hebei refugees from the fighting and to extend added relief wherever they arrived.

sentences.zh: 用山東西路宣撫副使完顏弼言，招大沫堌渠賊孫邦佐、張汝楫以五品職，下詔湔洗其罪。

translations.literal: Following the advice of Shandong East and West Route Pacification Vice-Commissioner Wanyan Bi, the bandit leaders Sun Bangzuo and Zhang Ruji of Damo Fortress were recruited with fifth-rank posts, and an edict washed away their crimes.
translations.idiomatic: On the advice of Shandong East and West Pacification Vice-Commissioner Wanyan Bi, Damo Fortress bandit chiefs Sun Bangzuo and Zhang Ruji were recruited at the fifth rank and an edict pardoned their crimes.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔檢核朝廷差遣官券曆，無故稽留中道者罪之。

translations.literal: On yimao an edict ordered audit of the travel-voucher records of officials dispatched by the court; those who without cause delayed en route were to be punished.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao an edict ordered review of travel-voucher records for court-dispatched officials, with punishment for those who stalled en route without cause.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，諭田琢留山西流民少壯者充軍，老幼者令就食于邢、洺等州，欲趣河南者聽。

translations.literal: On bingchen Tian Zhuo was instructed to keep able-bodied Shanxi refugees for the army, send the old and young to find food in Xing, Mo, and other prefectures, and allow those wishing Henan to go.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Tian Zhuo was told to keep able-bodied Shanxi refugees as soldiers, send the old and young to Xing, Mo, and other prefectures for subsistence, and let those bound for Henan proceed.

sentences.zh: 上議遣親軍六千餘及所募二千七百人援中都，宰臣以為行宮單弱，親軍不可遣，遂止。

translations.literal: The emperor discussed sending more than six thousand personal guards and twenty-seven hundred recruits to relieve the Central Capital; the chief ministers held that the traveling palace was too weak and the personal guard could not be sent — and the plan was dropped.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor proposed sending more than six thousand personal guards and twenty-seven hundred recruits to relieve the Central Capital, but the chief ministers argued the traveling palace was too exposed and the guard could not be spared — so the dispatch was abandoned.

sentences.zh: 五月庚申，招撫山西軍民，仍降詔諭之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on gengshen: Shanxi’s troops and people were pacified and an edict of instruction was issued to them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on gengshen, Shanxi’s soldiers and people were pacified and an instructional edict was sent down.

sentences.zh: 是日，中都破，尚書右丞相兼都元帥定國公承暉死之。

translations.literal: That day the Central Capital fell; Right Chancellor of the Masters of Writing and Commander-in-Chief Duke of Ding Chenghui died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: That day the Central Capital fell; Right Chancellor and Commander-in-Chief Duke of Ding Chenghui died in the fighting.

sentences.zh: 戶部尚書任天寵、知大興府事高霖皆及於難。

translations.literal: Minister of Revenue Ren Tianchong and Daxing Prefect Gao Lin likewise perished in the disaster.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Revenue Ren Tianchong and Daxing Prefect Gao Lin also died in the disaster.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，降空名宣敕、紫衣師德號度牒，以補軍儲。

translations.literal: On renxu blank appointment edicts, purple-robe and virtue-title ordination certificates were issued to supplement military stores.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu blank appointment edicts and purple-robe virtue-title ordination certificates were sold to fill military coffers.

sentences.zh: 辛未，立皇孫鏗為皇太孫。

translations.literal: On xinwei the imperial grandson Keng was established as imperial grandson heir.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei the imperial grandson Keng was made imperial grandson heir.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，劉炳上書言十事。

translations.literal: On guiyou Liu Bing memorialized ten items.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Liu Bing memorialized ten items.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，上諭宰臣：「多事之秋，陳言者悉送省。

translations.literal: On xinsi the emperor told the chief ministers: "In this season of many troubles, let every memorial be sent to the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi the emperor told the chief ministers, "In this season of troubles every memorial should go to the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 恐卿等不暇，朕于宮中置局，命方正官數員擇可取者付出施行，何如？

translations.literal: I fear you have no leisure for it — suppose I set up a bureau in the palace and appoint several upright-selection officers to pick what can be used and send it out for implementation. What of it?
translations.idiomatic: I fear you lack the time — what if I set up a bureau in the palace and name several upright-selection officers to choose what is workable and send it out for action?"

sentences.zh: 」宰臣請如聖諭。

translations.literal: The chief ministers asked to follow the imperial instruction.
translations.idiomatic: The chief ministers asked to follow the imperial instruction.

sentences.zh: 詔削納馬補官恩例。

translations.literal: An edict curtailed the privilege of buying office by contributing horses.
translations.idiomatic: An edict curtailed the privilege of buying office by contributing horses.

sentences.zh: 戊子，謀代西夏，遣大臣鎮撫京兆。

translations.literal: On wuzi plans were laid to attack Western Xia, and a senior minister was sent to pacify Jingzhao.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi the court planned an attack on Western Xia and sent a senior minister to steady Jingzhao.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊午朔，大元兵收濟源縣。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on wuwu new moon: Great Yuan troops took Jiyuan County.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the wuwu new moon, Great Yuan forces captured Jiyuan County.

sentences.zh: 己未，征弓箭於內外品官，三品以上三副，四品、五品二副，余以等級征之。

translations.literal: On jiwei bows were levied from ranked officials inside and outside the capital — three sets from the third rank and above, two from the fourth and fifth, and the rest by graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei bows were levied from capital and provincial ranked officials: three sets from the third rank up, two from the fourth and fifth, and lesser ranks by graded quotas.

sentences.zh: 庚申，置陳、潁漕運提舉官，以戶部勾當官往來督察。

translations.literal: On gengshen transport-intendant posts for the Chen and Ying grain routes were established, with Households Ministry clerks sent back and forth to supervise.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen transport intendants were set up for the Chen and Ying grain routes, with Households Ministry clerks rotating to inspect them.

sentences.zh: 有星如太白，色青白，有尾，出紫微垣北極傍，入貫索中。

translations.literal: A star like Venus, blue-white in color and tailed, appeared beside the north pole of the Purple Forbidden Enclosure and entered the Coiled Prison.
translations.idiomatic: A blue-white, tailed star bright as Venus appeared by the north pole of the Purple Forbidden Enclosure and entered the Coiled Prison constellation.

sentences.zh: 上聞河北譏察官有要求民財始聽民渡河者，避兵民至或餓死、自溺，特命御史臺體訪之。

translations.literal: The emperor heard that some Hebei surveillance officials would let people cross the river only after demanding money, so that refugees sometimes starved or drowned; he specially ordered the Censorate to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: Learning that some Hebei surveillance officials extorted money before letting people cross the river, so refugees sometimes starved or drowned, the emperor ordered the Censorate to investigate.

sentences.zh: 又禁隨朝職官奪民碾磑以自營利。

translations.literal: Court officials on assignment were also forbidden to seize civilian grain mills for private profit.
translations.idiomatic: Officials at court on assignment were also forbidden to seize civilian grain mills for private gain.

sentences.zh: 詔河間有孤城，移其軍民就粟清州，括民間騾付諸軍，與馬參用。

translations.literal: An edict said Hejian had an isolated city: move its troops and people to Qing Prefecture for grain, requisition civilian mules for the army, and use them together with horses.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said Hejian held an isolated city — its troops and people were to move to Qing Prefecture for grain, civilian mules were to be levied for the army, and mules and horses were to serve together.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，議括官田及牧馬地以贍河北軍戶之徙河南者，已為民佃者俟獲畢日付之。

translations.literal: On xinyou it was proposed to survey state fields and horse pastures to support Hebei military households moved to Henan; where land was already rented to civilians, it would be handed over after the harvest.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou the court proposed surveying state fields and horse pastures to support Hebei military households resettled in Henan, with rented plots delivered after the harvest.

sentences.zh: 群臣迭言其不便，遂寢。

translations.literal: Ministers repeatedly said it would be inconvenient, and the plan was dropped.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers repeatedly protested the hardship, and the plan was dropped.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔河北郡縣軍須並減河南之半。

translations.literal: On guihai an edict ordered that military rations in Hebei prefectures and districts be cut to half the Henan scale.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai an edict cut military rations in Hebei prefectures and districts to half the Henan allowance.

sentences.zh: 定尚書所造諸符：樞密院鹿，宣撫司魚，統軍司虎。

translations.literal: The insignia on tallies forged by the Masters of Writing were fixed: deer for the Privy Council, fish for the Pacification Commission, tiger for the Unified Army Command.
translations.idiomatic: The Masters of Writing fixed tally insignia: deer for the Privy Council, fish for the Pacification Commission, tiger for the Unified Army Command.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，遣參知政事高汝礪往河南，便宜措置糧儲。

translations.literal: On bingyin Participation Councillor Gao Ruli was sent to Henan with discretionary authority over grain stores.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Participation Councillor Gao Ruli was sent to Henan with discretionary authority over grain stores.

sentences.zh: 製品官納弓箭之令，丁憂致仕者免。

translations.literal: The order for ranked officials to submit bows was applied; those in mourning or retired were exempt.
translations.idiomatic: The bow levy for ranked officials took effect, with exemptions for those in mourning or retired.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，借平陽民租一年。

translations.literal: On jiaxu one year’s rent from Pingyang was advanced as a loan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu one year’s rent from Pingyang was advanced as a loan.

sentences.zh: 詔職官更兵亡失告身，見任者保識即重給之，妄冒者從詐偽法。

translations.literal: An edict ruled that officials who lost appointment credentials in the fighting could have them reissued on the guarantee of their current superior; false claimants were punished under the statute on fraud.
translations.idiomatic: An edict allowed officials who lost appointment credentials in the fighting to have them reissued on their current superior’s guarantee; false claimants faced the fraud statute.

sentences.zh: 丙子，尚書省奏給皇太孫歲賜錢，上不從，曰：「繈褓兒安所用之。

translations.literal: On bingzi the Masters of Writing memorialized granting the imperial grandson heir an annual stipend; the emperor refused, saying: "What use has an infant in swaddling clothes for money?
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi the Masters of Writing asked to grant the imperial grandson heir an annual stipend; the emperor refused, saying, "What does an infant in swaddling need with money?

sentences.zh: 」詔致仕官俸給比南征時減其半。

translations.literal: An edict cut retired officials’ salaries to half the level of the southern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: An edict cut retired officials’ salaries to half what they had received during the southern campaign.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，肅宗神主至自中都，奉安於明俊殿。

translations.literal: On dingchou the spirit tablet of Emperor Suzong arrived from the Central Capital and was installed in Mingjun Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Emperor Suzong’s spirit tablet arrived from the Central Capital and was installed in Mingjun Hall.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，月入畢宿中，戊夜犯畢大星。

translations.literal: On wuyin the moon entered the Net asterism; in the wu watch it trespassed on the great star of Net.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin the moon entered the Net asterism; in the fifth watch it struck Net’s great star.

sentences.zh: 己卯，明德皇后神主至中都。

translations.literal: On jimao the spirit tablet of Empress Mingde reached the Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Empress Mingde’s spirit tablet reached the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 裁損宮中歲給有差。

translations.literal: Palace annual allotments were cut by graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Annual palace allotments were cut by graded amounts.

sentences.zh: 甲申，詔尚書省，行六部太多，其令各路運司兼之。

translations.literal: On jiashen an edict told the Masters of Writing that the traveling Six Ministries were too many and ordered each circuit transport office to take them over.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen an edict told the Masters of Writing the traveling Six Ministries were too numerous and ordered circuit transport offices to absorb their duties.

sentences.zh: 改交鈔名「貞祐寶券」。

translations.literal: The paper notes were renamed "Zhenyou Treasure Certificates."
translations.idiomatic: Paper notes were renamed "Zhenyou Treasure Certificates."

sentences.zh: 八月戊子朔，以陝西統軍使完顏合打簽樞密院事。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on wuzi new moon: Shaanxi Unified Army Commander Wanyan Heda was appointed to sign Privy Council documents.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the wuzi new moon, Shaanxi Unified Army Commander Wanyan Heda was appointed to countersign Privy Council documents.

sentences.zh: 己丑，制軍府庶事樞密院官須與經歷官裁決，經歷議是而院官不從，許直以聞。

translations.literal: On jichou an order on miscellaneous affairs of the Military Regulation Office required Bureau of Military Affairs officials to decide together with experience officers; if the experience officer's view was right and the bureau official would not follow, he was permitted to report directly to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou an order on Military Regulation Office business required Bureau of Military Affairs officers to decide matters jointly with experience officers; when an experience officer was right and a bureau officer refused to follow, he might report directly to the throne.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，詔遣官體究京西路親遷軍戶。

translations.literal: On guisi an edict dispatched officials to investigate thoroughly the voluntarily relocated military households of the Jingxi circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi an edict sent officials to look into the voluntarily relocated military households of the Jingxi circuit.

sentences.zh: 丙申，諭尚書省，職官犯罪。

translations.literal: On bingchen the emperor instructed the Ministry of the Masters of Writing regarding crimes by officials in office.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen the emperor instructed the Ministry of the Masters of Writing on crimes committed by serving officials.

sentences.zh: 大者即施行之，小者籍之，事定始論其罪，諭樞密院，撒合輦所簽軍有具戒僧人，可罷遣之。

translations.literal: Major cases were to be carried out at once; minor ones were to be registered, and guilt was to be judged only after affairs were settled; the Bureau of Military Affairs was instructed that among the troops Sahelun had signed up there were monks who had received the full precepts — they might be dismissed and sent away.
translations.idiomatic: Major cases were to be executed immediately; minor ones were to be recorded and punished only once matters were settled. The Bureau of Military Affairs was told that Sahelun's enrolled troops included fully ordained monks and that these should be dismissed.

sentences.zh: 己亥，詔武舉官非見任及已從軍者，隨處調赴京師，別為一軍，以備用。

translations.literal: On jihai an edict ordered that military examination appointees who were not in current posts and those already in the army be transferred wherever they were to the capital, formed into a separate army, and held in reserve.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai an edict ordered military examination appointees not in current office and men already in service to be summoned from wherever they were to the capital, formed into a separate army, and held in reserve.

sentences.zh: 被薦未授官者，量才任之。

translations.literal: Those recommended but not yet granted office were to be employed according to their talent.
translations.idiomatic: Recommended men not yet given office were to be employed according to their ability.

sentences.zh: 庚子，上慮平陽城大，兵食不足，議棄之，宰臣持不可。

translations.literal: On gengzi the emperor worried that Pingyang city was large and provisions for the army insufficient and discussed abandoning it; the chief ministers held that it could not be done.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi the emperor, fearing Pingyang was too large and army grain too short, discussed abandoning it; the chief ministers insisted it could not be done.

sentences.zh: 賞前冀州教授粘割忒鄰，集義兵，出方略，遏土寇，兵後攝州，復立州治，積芻糧，招徠民戶至五萬，特遷三官，升正五品職。

translations.literal: Former Jizhou instructor Nian'ge Telin, for raising a righteous militia, putting forth strategy, checking local bandits, after the fighting acting as prefect and restoring the prefectural administration, amassing fodder and grain, and drawing households back until they reached fifty thousand, was specially promoted three ranks and advanced to a regular fifth-rank post.
translations.idiomatic: Former Jizhou Instructor Nian'ge Telin, who had raised a righteous militia, offered strategy, checked local bandits, after the fighting served as acting prefect and restored the prefecture, stockpiled fodder and grain, and drew back households until they reached fifty thousand, was specially promoted three ranks and advanced to a regular fifth-rank post.

sentences.zh: 置山東西路總管府于歸德府及徐、亳二州。

translations.literal: A Shandong West Circuit general directorate was established at Guide Prefecture and in Xu and Bo prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: A Shandong West Circuit general directorate was set up at Guide Prefecture and in Xu and Bo prefectures.

sentences.zh: 乙太常卿侯摯為參知政事，行尚書省于河北東、西兩路。

translations.literal: Grand Master of Ceremonies Hou Zhi was made participation councillor, with a traveling Ministry of the Masters of Writing in the Hebei East and West circuits.
