translations.idiomatic: Grand Master of Ceremonies Hou Zhi was appointed participation councillor and given a traveling Ministry of the Masters of Writing over the Hebei East and West circuits.

sentences.zh: 太祖御容至自西京，奉安于啟慶宮。

translations.literal: The Taizu imperial portrait arrived from the Western Capital and was installed in Qiqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: The Taizu imperial portrait arrived from the Western Capital and was installed in Qiqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，置行樞密院於徐州、歸德府。

translations.literal: On jiachen traveling bureaus of military affairs were established at Xuzhou and Guide Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen traveling bureaus of military affairs were established at Xuzhou and Guide Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 詔諸職官不拘何從出身，其才可大用者尚書省具以聞。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that for all officials, regardless of what path they came from, if their talent could be greatly used the Ministry of the Masters of Writing was to report them in detail.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that officials of whatever background, if their talent warranted great employment, be reported in detail by the Ministry of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 丙午，山東西路宣撫使完顏弼表：「遙授同知東平府事張汝楫將謀復叛，密遣人招同知益都府事孫邦佐。

translations.literal: On bingwu Shandong West Circuit pacification commissioner Wanyan Bi memorialized: "Titular concurrent Dongping prefectural vice commissioner Zhang Ruji was about to rebel again; he secretly sent men to win over concurrent Yidu prefectural vice commissioner Sun Bangzuo.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Shandong West Pacification Commissioner Wanyan Bi reported, "Titular Concurrent Vice Commissioner of Dongping Zhang Ruji was plotting to rebel again and secretly sent men to win over Concurrent Vice Commissioner of Yidu Sun Bangzuo.

sentences.zh: 邦佐斬其人，馳報弼，弼殺汝楫及其党萬餘。

translations.literal: Bangzuo beheaded the men and rode at speed to report to Bi; Bi killed Ruji and more than ten thousand of his faction.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Bangzuo executed the envoys and rode in haste to inform Bi, who killed Zhang Ruji and more than ten thousand of his party.

sentences.zh: 承制升邦佐德州防禦使，余立功者賞有差。

translations.literal: By imperial commission Bangzuo was promoted to Defender of Dezhou; the rest who had merit were rewarded in differing grades.
translations.idiomatic: By imperial commission Sun Bangzuo was made Defender of Dezhou; others who had merit were rewarded in differing grades.

sentences.zh: 」上嘉弼功，加崇進，封密國公，詔獎諭之。

translations.literal: " The emperor praised Bi's achievement, added the rank of elevated merit, enfeoffed him Duke of Mi, and issued an edict of reward and instruction.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor praised Bi's achievement, added the rank of elevated merit, enfeoffed him Duke of Mi, and issued an edict of reward and instruction.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詔近臣舉良將，加孫邦佐昭毅大將軍、泰定軍節度使，仍官其子。

translations.literal: On dingwei an edict ordered close ministers to recommend able generals; Sun Bangzuo was made General of Illustrious Valor and military commissioner of the Taiding Army, and his son was also given office.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei an edict called on close ministers to recommend able generals; Sun Bangzuo was made General of Illustrious Valor and military commissioner of the Taiding Army, and his son was also given office.

sentences.zh: 戊申，東平、益都、太原、潞州置元帥府。

translations.literal: On wushen marshal headquarters were established at Dongping, Yidu, Taiyuan, and Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen marshal headquarters were set up at Dongping, Yidu, Taiyuan, and Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 大赦。

translations.literal: A great amnesty was granted.
translations.idiomatic: A great amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 己酉，監察御史許古獻恢復中都之策。

translations.literal: On jiyou investigating censor Xu Gu submitted a plan to recover the Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Investigating Censor Xu Gu submitted a plan to recover the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 紅襖賊掠成武，宣撫副使顏盞天澤討走之，斬首數百級。

translations.literal: Red Jacket bandits raided Chengwu; pacification vice commissioner Yanzhan Tianze attacked and drove them off, beheading several hundred.
translations.idiomatic: Red Jacket bandits raided Chengwu; Pacification Vice Commissioner Yanzhan Tianze routed them and beheaded several hundred.

sentences.zh: 進天澤一官，將校有功者命就遷賞。

translations.literal: Tianze was promoted one rank; officers and soldiers with merit were ordered rewarded on the spot.
translations.idiomatic: Tianze was promoted one rank; meritorious officers and soldiers were ordered rewarded where they stood.

sentences.zh: 命侯摯招邢州賊程邦傑以官，不從則誘其黨圖之。

translations.literal: Hou Zhi was ordered to win over the Xingzhou bandit Cheng Bangjie with office; if he would not submit, his faction was to be enticed and plotted against.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Zhi was ordered to win over the Xingzhou bandit Cheng Bangjie with office, and if he refused, to work through his followers against him.

sentences.zh: 減戶部幹辦官四員及委差官有差。

translations.literal: Four executive officers of the Ministry of Revenue and commissioned officials were reduced in differing degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Four Ministry of Revenue executive officers and commissioned officials were cut in differing degrees.

sentences.zh: 壬子，置行省於陝西。

translations.literal: On renzi a traveling secretariat was established in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi a traveling secretariat was established in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，增沿河闌糴之法，十取其八，以抑販粟之幣，仍嚴禁私渡。

translations.literal: On yimao the riverine barrier-purchase of grain was strengthened: eight of ten were taken, to restrain the currency of grain-selling, and private crossings were strictly forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao the riverine barrier-purchase of grain was tightened to take eight of ten, to check speculation in grain sales, and private crossings were strictly forbidden.

sentences.zh: 增步軍萬人戍京以西，四萬人戍京以東。

translations.literal: Infantry were increased by ten thousand to garrison west of the capital and forty thousand east of the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Ten thousand infantry were added to garrison west of the capital and forty thousand east of it.

sentences.zh: 選陝西騎兵二千，增京畿之衛。

translations.literal: Two thousand Shaanxi cavalry were selected to strengthen the capital guard.
translations.idiomatic: Two thousand Shaanxi cavalry were chosen to reinforce the capital guard.

sentences.zh: 諭陝西，堅守延安、臨洮、環、慶、蘭、會、保安、綏德、平涼、德順、鎮戎、涇原、酈、坊、邠、寧、乾、耀等處要害。

translations.literal: Shaanxi was instructed to hold firm the strategic points Yan'an, Lintao, Huan, Qing, Lan, Hui, Bao'an, Suide, Pingliang, Deshun, Zhenrong, Jingyuan, Li, Fang, Bin, Ning, Qian, and Yao.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi was ordered to hold firm Yan'an, Lintao, Huan, Qing, Lan, Hui, Bao'an, Suide, Pingliang, Deshun, Zhenrong, Jingyuan, Li, Fang, Bin, Ning, Qian, Yao, and other key posts.

sentences.zh: 分渭南州郡步兵屯平涼，令宣撫使治邠州，副使治同州之澄城以統之。

translations.literal: Infantry from prefectures and districts south of the Wei were stationed at Pingliang; the pacification commissioner was ordered to administer from Bin Prefecture and the vice commissioner from Chengcheng in Tong Prefecture to command them.
translations.idiomatic: Infantry from prefectures and districts south of the Wei were posted at Pingliang; the pacification commissioner was to administer from Bin and the vice commissioner from Chengcheng in Tong to command them.

sentences.zh: 更以步騎守沿渭諸津。

translations.literal: Foot and horse were reassigned to guard the fords along the Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Foot and horse were reassigned to guard the fords along the Wei.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，元帥左監軍兼知真定府事永錫坐援中都失律，削官爵，杖之八十。

translations.literal: On bingchen Marshal Left Supervisor and concurrent prefect of Zhending Yongxi, for breach of discipline in relieving the Central Capital, was stripped of office and rank and beaten eighty strokes.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Marshal Left Supervisor and Concurrent Prefect of Zhending Yongxi, for breach of discipline in the relief of the Central Capital, was stripped of office and rank and beaten eighty strokes.

sentences.zh: 九月丁巳朔，戶部侍郎奧屯阿虎言：「國家多故，職官往往不仕。

translations.literal: Ninth month, dingmao new moon: Vice Ministry Director Aotun Ahu said: "The state has many troubles; officials often do not take office.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao new moon of the ninth month Vice Ministry Director Aotun Ahu said, "The state has many troubles and officials often refuse to serve.

sentences.zh: 乞限以兩季，違者勿復任用。

translations.literal: We ask that a limit of two seasons be set; violators are not again to be appointed.
translations.idiomatic: We ask a limit of two seasons; violators should never again be appointed.

sentences.zh: 」上嫌其太重，命違限者止奪三官，降職三等，仍永不升注。

translations.literal: " The emperor thought it too severe and ordered that violators lose only three ranks, be demoted three grades, and never again be promoted in appointment registers.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor thought this too harsh and ordered that violators lose only three ranks, be demoted three grades, and never again be entered for promotion.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，除名永錫特遷信武將軍、息州刺史。

translations.literal: On xinyou the stripped Yongxi was specially made Trustworthy Martial General and prefect of Xi.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou the disgraced Yongxi was specially made Trustworthy Martial General and prefect of Xi.

sentences.zh: 甲子，諭宰臣，沿淮塘路以南地向授民業，今為豪勢據奪者，其令有司察之。

translations.literal: On jiazi the chief ministers were instructed that lands south of the Huai embankment roads that had been granted to the people for their livelihood but were now seized by powerful families were to be investigated by the relevant offices.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the chief ministers were told that lands south of the Huai embankment roads granted to the people for their livelihood but now seized by powerful families were to be investigated by the relevant offices.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，樞密院言：「陝西、河東世襲蕃部巡檢，昨與世襲猛安謀克例罷其俸。

translations.literal: On bingyin the Bureau of Military Affairs said: "In Shaanxi and Hedong the hereditary frontier-inspector posts of tribal departments — yesterday, along with hereditary military-assistant and colony chiefs, their salaries were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin the Bureau of Military Affairs said, "In Shaanxi and Hedong the hereditary tribal frontier inspectors — only yesterday, along with hereditary military-assistant and colony chiefs, their salaries were cut off.

sentences.zh: 今邊事方急，宜仍給之，庶獲其用。

translations.literal: Now with frontier affairs urgent, they should again receive them, so we may gain their use.
translations.idiomatic: With frontier affairs urgent, they should receive pay again so we may gain their service.

sentences.zh: 又西邊弓箭手有才武出眾，獲功未推賞者，令宣撫司核實以聞。

translations.literal: Further, on the western frontier any archers outstanding in martial talent who have won merit but not yet received reward — let the pacification offices verify and report."
translations.idiomatic: Further, any western archers of outstanding martial talent who have won merit but not yet been rewarded should be verified by the pacification offices and reported."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " Approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以秋稼未獲，禁軍官圍獵。

translations.literal: On dingmao, because the autumn grain was not yet harvested, military officers were forbidden to hunt.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, because the autumn crop was not yet in, military officers were forbidden to hunt.

sentences.zh: 詔授隱士王澮太中大夫、右諫議大夫，充遼東宣撫司參謀官。

translations.literal: An edict appointed the recluse Wang Huang Grand Master of the Palace and right remonstrator, and made him staff planner of the Liaodong Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: An edict appointed the recluse Wang Huang Grand Master of the Palace and right remonstrator and made him staff planner of the Liaodong Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，遙授武寧軍節度副使徒單吾典告平章政事抹撚盡忠逆謀，詔有司鞫之。

translations.literal: On wuchen titular Wuning Army deputy military commissioner Tushan Wudian reported that participation councillor Monian Jinzhong was plotting treason; an edict ordered the relevant offices to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Titular Wuning Army Deputy Military Commissioner Tushan Wudian reported that Participation Councillor Monian Jinzhong was plotting treason; an edict ordered the relevant offices to investigate.

sentences.zh: 設潼關提控總領軍馬等官。

translations.literal: Posts were established at Tong Pass to control and command all army and horse.
translations.idiomatic: Control posts commanding all troops and horses were established at Tong Pass.

sentences.zh: 辛未，置河北東路行總管府于原武、陽武、封丘、陳留、延津、通許、杞諸縣，以治所徙軍戶。

translations.literal: On xinwei a traveling general directorate of Hebei East Circuit was established in Yuanwu, Yangwu, Fengqiu, Chenliu, Yanjin, Tongxu, and Qi counties to administer relocated military households.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei a traveling general directorate of Hebei East Circuit was set up in Yuanwu, Yangwu, Fengqiu, Chenliu, Yanjin, Tongxu, and Qi to administer relocated military households.

sentences.zh: 命司屬令和尚等護治鞏國公按辰第。

translations.literal: Registry Director Heshang and others were ordered to supervise and manage Duke of Gong An Chen's residence.
translations.idiomatic: Registry Director Heshang and others were ordered to supervise Duke of Gong An Chen's residence.

sentences.zh: 上謂宰臣曰：「按辰所為不慎，或至犯法。

translations.literal: The emperor told the chief ministers: "An Chen is careless in conduct and may even come to break the law.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told the chief ministers, "An Chen is careless in his conduct and may even break the law.

sentences.zh: 舍之則理所不容，治之則失親親之道，但當設官以防之耳。

translations.literal: To spare him would not be allowed by principle; to punish him would violate the way of cherishing kin — one should only set officials to guard against it."
translations.idiomatic: To spare him would not stand with principle; to punish him would violate cherishing kin — officials should simply be set to guard against it."

sentences.zh: 」按辰尋以不法，謫博州防禦使。

translations.literal: " Shortly thereafter An Chen, for impropriety, was demoted to Bozhou defense commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Not long after, An Chen was punished for misconduct and demoted to defense commissioner of Bozhou.

sentences.zh: 黜衛紹王母李氏光獻皇后尊諡，神主在太廟，畫像在啟慶宮，並遷出之。

translations.literal: The posthumous title of Empress Guangxian, Lady Li mother of Wei Shaowang, was removed; her spirit tablet in the ancestral temple and her portrait in Qiqing Palace were both moved out.
translations.idiomatic: The court stripped Empress Guangxian — Wei Shaowang's mother, Lady Li — of her posthumous title and removed her spirit tablet from the ancestral temple and her portrait from Qiqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 陳州鎮防軍段仲連進羊三百，詔遷三官。

translations.literal: Chen Prefecture garrison commander Duan Zhonglian presented three hundred sheep; an edict promoted him three ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Duan Zhonglian of the Chen Prefecture garrison presented three hundred sheep; an edict advanced him three ranks.

sentences.zh: 命右丞汝礪詣陳州規畫糧儲。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Right Vice Director Gao Ruili to go to Chen Prefecture to plan grain stores.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Right Vice Director Gao Ruili to Chen Prefecture to organize grain reserves.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以蘇門縣為輝州。

translations.literal: On renshen Suimen County was made Huizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Suimen County was elevated to Huizhou.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，朝謁世祖、太祖御容于啟慶宮，行獻享禮，始用樂。

translations.literal: On guiyou he attended upon the imperial portraits of Shizu and Taizu at Qiqing Palace, performed the offering rite, and music was used for the first time.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou he paid court to the imperial portraits of Shizu and Taizu at Qiqing Palace, performed the offering rite, and used music for the first time.

sentences.zh: 賜東永昌姓為溫敦氏，包世顯、包疙疸為烏古論氏，睹令孤為和速嘉氏，何定為必蘭氏，馬福德、馬柏壽為夾穀氏，各遷一官。

translations.literal: Dong Yongchang was granted the surname Wendun; Bao Shixian and Bao Gedan the surname Wugulun; Du Linggu the surname Hesujia; He Ding the surname Biran; Ma Fude and Ma Baishou the surname Jiagu — each was promoted one rank.
translations.idiomatic: Dong Yongchang was given the surname Wendun; Bao Shixian and Bao Gedan the surname Wugulun; Du Linggu Hesujia; He Ding Biran; Ma Fude and Ma Baishou Jiagu — each advanced one rank.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，朝謁太宗、熙宗、睿宗御容，行獻享禮。

translations.literal: On jiaxu he attended upon the imperial portraits of Taizong, Xizong, and Ruizong and performed the offering rite.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu he paid court to the imperial portraits of Taizong, Xizong, and Ruizong and performed the offering rite.

sentences.zh: 詔開、滑、浚、濟、曹、滕諸州置連珠寨，如衛州。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Kai, Hua, Jun, Ji, Cao, and Teng prefectures to establish Linked Pearl Forts as at Weizhou.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Kai, Hua, Jun, Ji, Cao, and Teng to build Linked Pearl Forts on the Weizhou model.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，詔河北、山東等路及平涼、慶陽、臨洮府，涇、邠、秦、鞏、德順諸州經兵，四品以下職事官並以二十月為滿。

translations.literal: On yihai an edict ruled that in Hebei, Shandong, and other circuits and in Pingliang, Qingyang, and Lintao prefectures and Jing, Bin, Qin, Gong, and Deshun prefectures — all districts that had seen warfare — functional officials of the fourth rank and below would serve twenty-month terms.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai an edict set twenty-month terms for functional officials of the fourth rank and below in war-ravaged Hebei, Shandong, and other circuits, in Pingliang, Qingyang, and Lintao, and in Jing, Bin, Qin, Gong, and Deshun.

sentences.zh: 募隨處主帥及官軍、義軍將校，有能率眾復取中都者封王，遷一品階，授二品職。

translations.literal: Local commanders and garrison and militia officers who could lead troops to recover the Central Capital were recruited — such men would be enfeoffed as kings, advanced one rank in nobility, and appointed to second-rank office.
translations.idiomatic: The court recruited local commanders and garrison and militia officers able to lead troops to retake the Central Capital, promising enfeoffment as king, one noble rank, and a second-rank appointment.

sentences.zh: 能戰卻敵、善誘降人、取附都州縣者，予本處長官、散官，隨職遷授，餘州縣遞減二等。

translations.literal: Those who fought off the enemy, skillfully induced surrender, and recovered prefectures and counties near the capital would receive local magistrate and titular posts with promotion according to office; rewards for other prefectures and counties would be two ranks lower.
translations.idiomatic: Men who beat off the enemy, won surrenders, and recovered prefectures and counties near the capital would receive local magistrate and titular posts with promotion by merit; other prefectures and counties would be rewarded two ranks less.

sentences.zh: 紅襖賊周元兒陷深、祁州，束鹿、安平、無極等縣，真定帥府以計破之，斬元兒及殺其党五百餘人。

translations.literal: Red Coats bandit Zhou Yuan'er took Shen and Qi prefectures and Shulu, Anping, and Wuji counties; the Zhending commandery headquarters broke him by stratagem and executed Yuan'er, killing more than five hundred of his followers.
translations.idiomatic: The Red Coats bandit Zhou Yuan'er seized Shen and Qi and the counties of Shulu, Anping, and Wuji; the Zhending commandery headquarters routed him by stratagem, executed Yuan'er, and killed more than five hundred of his band.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔司、縣官能募民進糧五千石以上，減一資考，萬石以上，遷一官，減二資考，二萬石以上遷一官，升一等，注見闕。

translations.literal: On dingchou an edict ruled that bureau and county officials who could recruit civilians to bring in five thousand piculs of grain or more would have one evaluation reduced; ten thousand or more — one promotion and two evaluations reduced; twenty thousand or more — one promotion, one grade advanced, and appointment to a current vacancy.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou an edict promised that officials who recruited five thousand piculs or more would lose one evaluation cycle; ten thousand — one promotion and two cycles; twenty thousand — one promotion, one grade, and a current vacancy.

sentences.zh: 諸色人以功賜國姓者，能以千人敗敵三千人，賜及緦麻以上親，二千人以上，賜及大功以上親，千人以上，賜止其家。

translations.literal: For persons of all statuses granted the dynastic surname for merit: defeating three thousand enemies with one thousand earned the surname for relatives within five degrees of mourning; two thousand or more for relatives within great-achievement mourning; one thousand or more was limited to the household alone.
translations.idiomatic: For non-Jurchen granted the dynastic surname on merit: one thousand men beating three thousand extended it to five-degree kin; two thousand to great-achievement kin; one thousand or more was confined to the household.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，陝西宣撫司來上第五將城萬戶楊再興擊走夏人之捷。

translations.literal: On gengchen the Shaanxi Pacification Commission reported the victory of Fifth Fort Wanhu Yang Zaixing in beating off the Xia.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Shaanxi reported Fifth Fort Wanhu Yang Zaixing's victory in driving off the Xia.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以空名宣敕付陝西宣撫司，凡夏人入寇，有能臨陣立功者，五品以下並聽遷授。

translations.literal: On renwu blank commission edicts were issued to the Shaanxi Pacification Commission: for merit in battle when Xia raided, all of fifth rank and below would be promoted on report.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu blank commission edicts went to Shaanxi: any man of fifth rank or below who distinguished himself when Xia raided might be promoted on report.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，置大名府行總管府于柘城縣，以治所徙軍戶。

translations.literal: On yiyou a traveling headquarters of Daming Prefecture was established at Zhecheng County to administer relocated military households.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou a traveling Daming headquarters was set up at Zhecheng to govern relocated military households.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙戌朔，翰林侍讀學士、權參知政事烏古論德升出為集慶軍節度使兼亳州管內觀察使。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, bingxu new moon: Hanlin Academician Reader and Acting Participation Councillor Wugulun Desheng went out as military commissioner of Jiqing Army and concurrent inspector of Bozhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month, on the bingxu new moon, Hanlin Reader and Acting Participation Councillor Wugulun Desheng left court for Jiqing Army commissioner and concurrent Bozhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，尚書右丞汝礪言：「河北軍戶之徙河南省，宜以系官閒田及牧馬草地之可耕者賜之，使自耕以食，而罷其月糧。

translations.literal: On dinghai Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Gao Ruili said: "The Hebei military households relocated to Henan should be given idle official fields and arable pasture land to farm for themselves, and their monthly grain rations stopped."
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Right Vice Director Gao Ruili said, "Hebei military households moved to Henan should receive idle official fields and cultivable pasture to feed themselves, and their monthly rations should end."

sentences.zh: 」上從其請。

translations.literal: " The emperor granted his request.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 命右司諫馮開隨處按視，人給三十畝。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Right Office Remonstrator Feng Kai to inspect everywhere and grant thirty mu per person.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Right Office Remonstrator Feng Kai to inspect on the spot and grant thirty mu per person.

sentences.zh: 夏人入保安，都統完顏國家奴破之；

translations.literal: Xia entered Bao'an; Commander-in-Chief Wanyan Guojianu defeated them;
translations.idiomatic: Xia raided Bao'an; Commander-in-Chief Wanyan Guojianu routed them;

sentences.zh: 攻延安，戍將又敗之。

translations.literal: they attacked Yan'an and the garrison commander defeated them again.
translations.idiomatic: they struck Yan'an and the garrison commander beat them off again.

sentences.zh: 是日，捷至。

translations.literal: That day the victories were reported.
translations.idiomatic: That day word of victory arrived.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以御史中丞徒單思忠為參知政事。

translations.literal: On wuzi Censor-in-Chief Tushan Sizhong was made Participation Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Censor-in-Chief Tushan Sizhong was appointed participation councillor.

sentences.zh: 己丑，平章抹撚盡忠下獄既久，監察御史許古言：「盡忠逮系有司，此必重罪，而莫知其由，甚駭眾聽。

translations.literal: On jichou Grand Councilor Monian Jinzhong had long been in prison; Supervising Censor Xu Gu said: "Jinzhong has been detained by the judicial authorities — this must be a grave crime, yet no one knows the reason, which greatly alarms public opinion."
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Grand Councilor Monian Jinzhong had been imprisoned a long time; Supervising Censor Xu Gu said, "Jinzhong is held by the courts on what must be a capital charge, yet no one knows why — the uproar is extreme."

sentences.zh: 乞遣公正重臣鞫之。

translations.literal: " I beg that just and weighty ministers be sent to try the case."
translations.idiomatic: "Send upright senior ministers to try him."

sentences.zh: 如得其實，明示罪目，以厭中外之心。

translations.literal: " If the facts are found, let the charges be made clear to satisfy court and country."
translations.idiomatic: "If guilt is proved, publish the crimes to quiet court and realm."

sentences.zh: 」書上，不報。

translations.literal: " The memorial was submitted; no reply was given.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was filed; no answer came.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，遂誅盡忠。

translations.literal: On gengyin Jinzhong was thereupon executed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Jinzhong was put to death.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，罪狀盡忠告中外。

translations.literal: On guisi the charges against Jinzhong were announced within and without.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Jinzhong's crimes were proclaimed at court and in the realm.

sentences.zh: 詔樞密副使僕散安貞行樞密院於徐州。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Deputy Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs Pusan Anzhen to conduct the Bureau at Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: An edict sent Deputy Military Affairs Commissioner Pusan Anzhen to run the Bureau at Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，遼東宣撫司報敗留哥之捷。

translations.literal: On wuxu the Liaodong Pacification Commission reported victory in defeating Yelu Liuge.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Liaodong reported victory over Yelu Liuge.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，詔求廣平郡王承暉之後，得其猶子曆亭縣丞永懷，以為器物直長。

translations.literal: On jiachen an edict sought descendants of Prince of Guangping Commandery Chenghui; they found his great-nephew Liting County Assistant Magistrate Yonghuai and appointed him Director of Ritual Vessels.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen the court sought descendants of Prince of Guangping Chenghui, found his great-nephew Assistant Magistrate Yonghuai of Liting, and made him Director of Ritual Vessels.

sentences.zh: 丙午，夏人陷臨洮，陝西宣撫副使完顏胡失剌被執。

translations.literal: On bingwu Xia took Lintao; Shaanxi Pacification Vice Commissioner Wanyan Hushila was captured.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Xia seized Lintao; Shaanxi Vice Pacification Commissioner Wanyan Hushila was taken.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，詔尚書左丞相僕散端兼都元帥，行尚書省於陝西。

translations.literal: On gengxu an edict made Left Chief Councillor Pusan Duan concurrent Commander-in-Chief and sent the Masters of Writing headquarters to Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Left Chief Councillor Pusan Duan was made concurrent commander-in-chief and dispatched to Shaanxi with the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，蒙古綱奏：「昨被旨權山東路宣副使，屯東平。

translations.literal: On xinhai Mongol Gang memorialized: "Yesterday by edict I was temporarily made Shandong Route pacification vice commissioner and encamped at Dongping."
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Mongol Gang reported, "Yesterday I was ordered acting Shandong vice pacification commissioner and encamped at Dongping."

sentences.zh: 行至徐北岸，北兵已逼徐，不可往。

translations.literal: " Reaching the north bank of Xu, northern troops had already pressed Xu and I could not go."
translations.idiomatic: "At the Xu north bank the northern army had already closed on Xu and I could not advance."

sentences.zh: 」詔樞密副使僕散安貞權于沿河任使之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Deputy Commissioner of Military Affairs Pusan Anzhen to exercise temporary authority along the river as needed.
translations.idiomatic: An edict gave Deputy Military Affairs Commissioner Pusan Anzhen discretionary command along the river.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以同、華舊屯陝西兵及河南所移步騎舊隸陝州宣撫司者，改隸陝西行省。

translations.literal: On renzi former Shaanxi troops garrisoned at Tong and Hua and foot and horse formerly under Shaan Prefecture Pacification Commission that had been moved to Henan were all reassigned to Shaanxi Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi former Shaanxi garrisons at Tong and Hua and the foot and horse once under Shaan Pacification but moved to Henan were all placed under the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 召中奉大夫、襲封衍聖公孔元措為太常博士。

translations.literal: Zhongfeng Grand Master and Hereditary Duke of Confucius Kong Yuancuo was summoned to be Doctor of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongfeng Grand Master and Hereditary Duke of Confucius Kong Yuancuo was called to be a doctor of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 上初用元措於朝，或言宣聖墳廟在曲阜，宜遣之奉祀。

translations.literal: When the emperor first used Yuancuo at court, some said the sage's shrine and temple were at Qufu and he ought to be sent to perform sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuancuo first served at court, some urged that Confucius' shrine at Qufu required his presence for sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 既而上念元措聖人之後，山東寇盜縱橫，恐罹其害，是使之奉祀而反絕之也，故有是命。

translations.literal: Yet the emperor reflected that Yuancuo was the sage's descendant and bandits and raiders ran rampant in Shandong; fearing he would suffer harm, sending him to perform sacrifice would amount to abandoning him — hence this appointment.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor reflected that Yuancuo was Confucius' heir and bandits ravaged Shandong; to send him to sacrifice would expose him to harm — hence this summons to court instead.

sentences.zh: 遼東賊蒲鮮萬奴僭號，改元天泰。

translations.literal: Liaodong rebel Puxian Wannu arrogated a reign title and changed the era name to Tiantai.
translations.idiomatic: Liaodong rebel Puxian Wannu declared himself ruler and adopted the era name Tiantai.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙辰朔，河北行尚書省侯摯入見。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, bingchen new moon: Hebei Branch Secretariat Hou Zhi had audience.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the bingchen new moon, Hebei Branch Secretariat Hou Zhi had audience.

sentences.zh: 詔河北西路宣撫副使田琢自浚徙其兵屯陝。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Hebei Western Route Pacification Vice Commissioner Tian Zhuo to move his troops from Jun to garrison Shaan.
translations.idiomatic: An edict moved Hebei Western Route Vice Pacification Commissioner Tian Zhuo's troops from Jun to garrison Shaan.

sentences.zh: 戊午，樞密院進王世安取盱眙、楚州之策，遂以世安為招撫使，與泗州元帥府所遣人同往淮南計度其事。

translations.literal: On wuwu the Bureau of Military Affairs presented Wang Shian's plan to take Xuyi and Chuzhou; he was made Pacification Commissioner and sent with men dispatched by the Xuzhou Marshal's headquarters to plan the affair in Huainan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu the Bureau of Military Affairs submitted Wang Shian's plan to take Xuyi and Chuzhou; he was made pacification commissioner and sent with Xuzhou headquarters troops to survey Huainan.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，夏人犯綏德之克戎寨，官軍敗之，犯綏平，又敗之。

translations.literal: On wuchen Xia raided Keron Fortress in Suide; government troops defeated them; they raided Suiping and were defeated again.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Xia struck Keron Fortress in Suide and were beaten; they raided Suiping and were beaten again.

sentences.zh: 賞有功將士告捷者。

translations.literal: Those who had reported victory were rewarded according to merit.
translations.idiomatic: Meritorious officers who had reported victory were rewarded.

sentences.zh: 參知政事徒單思忠言：「今陳言者多掇拾細故，乞不送省，止令近侍局度其可否發遣。

translations.literal: Participation Councillor Tushan Sizhong said: "Nowadays those who offer memorials mostly pick up minor details; we beg that they not be sent to the Secretariat but only let the Palace Service Bureau judge whether they may be dispatched."
translations.idiomatic: Participation Councillor Tushan Sizhong said, "Memorialists today mostly scrape together trifles; we ask that such papers not go to the Secretariat but that the Palace Service Bureau alone decide what may be sent on."

sentences.zh: 」上曰：「若爾，是塞言路。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "If so, that blocks the avenue of speech."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "That would choke off the avenue of remonstrance."

sentences.zh: 凡系國家者，豈得不由尚書省乎？

translations.literal: Whatever concerns the state — how can it not go through the Secretariat?
translations.idiomatic: Whatever touches the state — how can it bypass the Secretariat?"

sentences.zh: 」庚午，上與尚書右丞汝礪商略遣官括田賜軍之利害，汝礪言不便者數端。

translations.literal: On gengwu the emperor discussed with Vice Director of the Secretariat Gao Ruli the advantages and harms of dispatching officials to register land and grant it to the army; Ruli stated several inconveniences.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu the emperor reviewed with Secretariat Vice Director Gao Ruli the pros and cons of sending officials to survey land for military grants; Ruli cited several drawbacks.

sentences.zh: 乃詔有司罷其令，仍給軍糧之半，其半給詣實之價。

translations.literal: Thereupon an edict ordered the responsible offices to abolish that order, still giving the army half its grain ration; the other half was to be given as the price for on-site verification.
translations.idiomatic: An edict then abolished the order, still paying troops half their grain ration while the other half went as compensation for field verification.

sentences.zh: 壬申，遣參知政事侯摯祭河神於宜村。

translations.literal: On renshen Participation Councillor Hou Zhi was sent to sacrifice to the river god at Yicun.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Participation Councillor Hou Zhi was sent to sacrifice to the river god at Yicun.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，移剌塔不也以軍萬人破夏人數萬於熟羊寨。

translations.literal: On jiaxu Yelü Tabuye with ten thousand troops defeated tens of thousands of Xia at Shuyang Fortress.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Yelü Tabuye with ten thousand men routed tens of thousands of Xia at Shuyang Fortress.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔市民間輓車羸疾牝馬置群牧中，以圖滋息。

translations.literal: On bingzi an edict ordered that weak, sick female horses from civilian draft carts be placed in the herd offices to promote breeding.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi an edict ordered weak and sick draft mares from among the people placed in the state herds to improve breeding stock.

sentences.zh: 知臨洮府陀滿胡土門破夏人八萬於城下。

translations.literal: Lintao Prefect Tuoman Hutumen defeated eighty thousand Xia below the city.
translations.idiomatic: Lintao Prefect Tuoman Hutumen defeated eighty thousand Xia beneath the walls.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，監察御史陳規劾參知政事侯摯，上不允所言，而慰答之。

translations.literal: On dingchou Supervising Censor Chen Gui impeached Participation Councillor Hou Zhi; the emperor did not accept what was said but comforted and replied.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Supervising Censor Chen Gui impeached Participation Councillor Hou Zhi; the emperor rejected the charges but reassured him.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，上謂宰臣曰：「朕恐括地擾民，罷其令矣。

translations.literal: On gengchen the emperor told the chief ministers: "I feared that registering land would disturb the people and abolished that order."
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen the emperor told the chief ministers, "I feared land registration would harass the people and have abolished the order."

sentences.zh: 官荒牧馬地軍戶願耕者聽，已為民承種者勿奪。

translations.literal: Where official waste pasture is desired for cultivation by military households, allow it; where civilians already hold the planting, do not seize it.
translations.idiomatic: Where idle official pasture is wanted by military households for planting, permit it; fields already under civilian cultivation must not be taken."

sentences.zh: 舊列點檢左右將軍、近侍局官、護衛、承應人秩滿皆賜匹帛，雖所司為之製造，然不免賦取於民，近亦罷之，止給寶券。

translations.literal: Formerly the inspecting left and right generals, Palace Service Bureau officials, guards, and attendants at the end of their terms all received bolts of silk — though the responsible office made them, they could not avoid levying from the people; recently this too was abolished, and only treasury notes are given.
translations.idiomatic: Inspecting left and right generals, Palace Service Bureau officers, guards, and attendants used to receive bolts of silk at term's end — though the office wove them, levies on the people could not be avoided; that gift too was lately ended, and only treasury notes are issued.

sentences.zh: 至於朕所服御，亦以官絲付府監織之，自今勿復及民也。

translations.literal: As for what I wear, official silk is also given to the palace workshops to weave; from now on let it not again reach the people.
translations.idiomatic: Even my own garments are woven from official silk in the palace workshops; from now on let the people not be touched for it again."

sentences.zh: 」大元兵徇彰德府，知府陀滿斜烈死之。

translations.literal: Great Yuan troops ranged against Zhangde Prefecture; Prefect Tuoman Xielie died in the defense.
translations.idiomatic: Great Yuan forces overran Zhangde Prefecture; Prefect Tuoman Xielie died defending it.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月癸亥，監察御史田迥秀條陳五事。

translations.literal: Spring, first month of year 4, on jiahai: Supervising Censor Tian Huixiu set forth five items.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in year 4, on jiahai, Supervising Censor Tian Huixiu memorialized five items.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，紅襖賊犯泰安、德、博等州，山東西路行元帥府敗之。

translations.literal: On bingyin Red-Robe bandits attacked Tai'an, De, Bo, and other prefectures; the Shandong West Circuit traveling marshalate defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Red-Robe rebels struck Tai'an, De, Bo, and other prefectures; the Shandong West Circuit traveling marshalate routed them.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，諭御史臺曰：「今旦視朝，百官既拜之後，始聞開封府報衙聲。

translations.literal: On dingmao the emperor instructed the Censorate: "At court this morning, after the hundred officials had bowed, only then did I hear Kaifeng Prefecture's yamen drum."
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao the emperor told the Censorate, "At audience this morning the hundred officials had already bowed before I heard Kaifeng Prefecture beat its yamen drum."

sentences.zh: 四方多故之秋，弛慢如此，可乎？

translations.literal: In an autumn of many troubles everywhere, slackness like this — can it be allowed?
translations.idiomatic: With trouble on every side, may such slackness be tolerated?"

sentences.zh: 中丞福興號素謹於官事者，當一詰之。

translations.literal: Vice Censor Fuxing is known as scrupulous in office; he should be questioned.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Censor Fuxing is said to be strict in office — let him be called to account."

sentences.zh: 」己巳，尚書右丞高汝礪進左丞。

translations.literal: On jisi Vice Director of the Secretariat Gao Ruli was promoted to Left Director.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Secretariat Vice Director Gao Ruli was promoted to Left Director.

sentences.zh: 庚午，大元兵收曹州。

translations.literal: On gengwu Great Yuan troops took Caozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Great Yuan forces captured Caozhou.

sentences.zh: 辛未，參知政事侯摯進尚書右丞。

translations.literal: On xinwei Participation Councillor Hou Zhi was promoted to Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Participation Councillor Hou Zhi was promoted to Secretariat Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 壬申，太原元帥左監軍烏古論德升招其民降北者，得四千三百餘人。

translations.literal: On renshen Taiyuan Marshal Left Supervisor Urgun Desheng recruited those of his people who had surrendered north, obtaining more than four thousand three hundred persons.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Taiyuan Marshal Left Supervisor Urgun Desheng won back more than four thousand three hundred of his people who had gone over to the north.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，詔賜故皇太孫諡曰沖懷。

translations.literal: On guiyou an edict granted the posthumous title Chonghuai to the late Imperial Grandson.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou an edict gave the late Imperial Grandson the posthumous title Chonghuai.

sentences.zh: 更定捕獲偽造寶券者官賞。

translations.literal: Rewards for officials who captured forgers of treasury notes were revised.
translations.idiomatic: Official rewards for capturing counterfeit treasury notes were revised.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以殿前都點檢皇子遂王守禮為樞密使，樞密使濮王守純為平章政事。

translations.literal: On yihai Palace Front Inspector-in-Chief Prince Sui Wang Shouli was made Military Affairs Commissioner; Military Affairs Commissioner Prince Pu Wang Shouchun was made Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Palace Front Inspector-in-Chief Prince Sui Wang Shouli became Military Affairs Commissioner, and Military Affairs Commissioner Prince Pu Wang Shouchun became Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 己卯，立遂王守禮為皇太子。

translations.literal: On jimao Prince Sui Wang Shouli was established as Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Prince Sui Wang Shouli was installed as Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，詔免逃戶租。

translations.literal: On gengchen an edict remitted rent for absconding households.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen an edict remitted rent owed by absconding households.

sentences.zh: 壬午，言者請遣官勸農，至秋成，考其績以甄賞。

translations.literal: On renwu memorializers asked to send officials to encourage agriculture; when the autumn harvest came, examine their performance for reward and promotion.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu memorialists asked to dispatch officials to encourage farming and, after the autumn harvest, grade their results for reward and promotion.

sentences.zh: 宰臣言：「民恃農以生，初不待勸，但寬其力，勿奪其時而已。

translations.literal: The chief ministers said: "The people rely on farming to live; at first they do not wait to be encouraged — only ease their labor and do not seize their season."
translations.idiomatic: The chief ministers said, "The people live by the plow and need no urging at the outset — only lighten their burdens and do not steal their season."

sentences.zh: 遣官不過督州縣計頃畝、嚴期會而已。

translations.literal: Sending officials is only to press prefectures and districts to count mu and enforce deadlines.
translations.idiomatic: Dispatching officers only drives prefectures and districts to tally acreage and meet deadlines.

sentences.zh: 吏卒因為奸利，是乃妨農，何名為勸。

translations.literal: Clerks and soldiers thereby make illicit profit — that harms farming; what is it called encouragement?
translations.idiomatic: Clerks and runners then prey on the people — that harms farming; how is it encouragement?"

sentences.zh: 」上是其言，不遣。

translations.literal: The emperor approved their words and did not dispatch.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor agreed and sent no one.

sentences.zh: 二月甲申朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Second month, first day jiashen: there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen new moon of the second month the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 上不視朝，詔皇太子控制樞密院事。

translations.literal: The emperor did not hold court; an edict ordered the Crown Prince to control Military Affairs Commission affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor did not attend court; an edict put Military Affairs Commission business under the Crown Prince's direction.

sentences.zh: 大元兵圍太原。

translations.literal: Great Yuan troops besieged Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Great Yuan forces besieged Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以信武將軍、宣撫副使永錫簽樞密院事，權尚書右丞。

translations.literal: On yiyou Trustworthy Martial General and Pacification Vice Commissioner Yong Xi was appointed to sign Military Affairs Commission affairs and serve as acting Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Trustworthy Martial General and Pacification Vice Commissioner Yong Xi was named to sign Military Affairs Commission papers and act as Secretariat Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 皇太子既總樞務，詔有司議典禮，以金鑄「撫軍之寶」授太子，啟稟之際用之。

translations.literal: Since the Crown Prince now oversaw military affairs, an edict ordered the responsible offices to deliberate ritual, to cast in gold a "Seal of Pacifying the Army" for the prince, to be used when opening and reporting.
translations.idiomatic: With the Crown Prince now directing military affairs, an edict had the offices devise ritual and cast in gold a "Seal of Pacifying the Army" for the prince to use when opening and reporting business.

sentences.zh: 平章政事高琪表乞致仕，不允。

translations.literal: Grand Councilor Gao Qi memorialized begging to retire; not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Councilor Gao Qi asked to retire; the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 如樞密院官問所以備禦之策。

translations.literal: He was questioned, as Military Affairs Commission officials were, on plans for defense.
translations.idiomatic: He was questioned, like Military Affairs commissioners, on plans for defense.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以河東南路宣撫使胥鼎為樞密副使，權尚書左丞，行省於平陽。

translations.literal: On dinghai Hedong South Circuit Pacification Commissioner Xu Ding was made Military Affairs Vice Commissioner, acting Left Director of the Secretariat, with a traveling office at Pingyang.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Hedong South Circuit Pacification Commissioner Xu Ding became Military Affairs Vice Commissioner and acting Secretariat Left Director, with his headquarters at Pingyang.

sentences.zh: 鼎方抗表求退，詔勉諭就職，因有是命。

translations.literal: Ding was then resisting with a memorial begging to withdraw; the edict exhorted and urged him to take office — hence this appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Ding had been pleading illness to resign; the edict urged him back to duty — hence this appointment.

sentences.zh: 行省左丞相僕散端先亦告老，遣太醫往鎮護視其疾。

translations.literal: Traveling Secretariat Left Director Pusandan Duan had also earlier requested retirement on account of age; the imperial physician was sent to attend and look after his illness.
translations.idiomatic: Traveling Secretariat Left Director Pusandan Duan had also sought retirement for age; an imperial physician was sent to tend him.

sentences.zh: 戊子，宰臣以皇太子既立，服御儀物悉與已受冊同，今邊事未寧，請少緩冊寶之禮，從之。

translations.literal: On wuzi the chief ministers, since the Crown Prince was already established and his apparel and ritual objects were all the same as when he had received investiture, with frontier affairs not yet settled asked to defer slightly the seal and treasure ceremony — approved.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi the chief ministers, noting that the Crown Prince was already installed with regalia matching full investiture and that the frontier was still unsettled, asked to postpone the seal-and-treasure ceremony slightly — and were approved.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，免親王、公主長春節入賀致禮。

translations.literal: On wuxu exemption for princes and princesses from entering congratulations and performing ritual on the Long Spring Festival.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu princes and princesses were excused from attending the Long Spring Festival to offer congratulations and ritual.

sentences.zh: 己亥，大元兵攻下霍山諸隘。

translations.literal: On jihai Great Yuan troops took the passes of Huoshan.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Great Yuan forces seized the Huoshan passes.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，命參知政事李革為修奉太廟使，禮部尚書張行信提控修奉社稷。

translations.literal: On jiachen Participation Councillor Li Ge was made Commissioner for Repair and Service of the Imperial Ancestral Temple; Minister of Rites Zhang Xingxin was put in charge of repairing and serving the Altar of Soil and Grain.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Participation Councillor Li Ge was made Commissioner for Repair and Service of the Imperial Ancestral Temple, and Minister of Rites Zhang Xingxin was charged with repairing and serving the Altar of Soil and Grain.

sentences.zh: 權祔肅宗神主于世祖室，奉始祖以下神主於隨室，祭器以瓦代銅，獻官以公服行事，供張等物並從簡約。

translations.literal: Suzong's spirit tablet was provisionally enshrined in Taizu's chamber; spirit tablets from the Founding Ancestor downward were placed in attendant chambers; ritual vessels of tile replaced bronze; offering officials acted in plain robes; furnishings and the like all followed simplicity and restraint.
translations.idiomatic: Suzong's tablet was provisionally placed in Taizu's shrine; tablets from the Founding Ancestor down were lodged in side chambers; bronze vessels gave way to pottery; offering officers wore plain dress; and all furnishings were kept spare.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，詔凡死節之臣籍其數，立廟致祭。

translations.literal: On gengxu an edict ordered that the number of officials who died loyal be registered and temples erected for sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu an edict ordered loyal dead officials registered by name and temples raised for their sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 壬子，任國公瑋薨，輟朝。

translations.literal: On renzi Duke of Ren State Wei died; court audiences were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Duke of Ren State Wei died, and court audiences were suspended.

sentences.zh: 是月，同知觀州軍州事張開復河間府滄、獻等州並屬縣十有三，表請赦旁郡脅從之臣。

translations.literal: That month, Associate Commissioner of Guan Prefecture Military and Civil Affairs Zhang Kai recovered Hejian Prefecture's Cang, Xian, and other prefectures together with thirteen subordinate counties, and memorialized asking amnesty for coerced subjects in neighboring commanderies.
translations.idiomatic: That month Zhang Kai, associate commissioner of Guan Prefecture, recovered Hejian together with Cang, Xian, and thirteen subordinate counties, and asked a partial amnesty for coerced subjects in neighboring circuits.

sentences.zh: 又請以宣撫司空名宣敕二百道付之，從權署補，仍以糧繼其軍食。

translations.literal: He also asked that two hundred blank commissions bearing the Pacification Commissioner's seal be given him for provisional appointment and supplementation, and that grain continue to supply his army.
translations.idiomatic: He also requested two hundred blank Pacification Commissioner commissions for provisional appointments and continued grain for his troops.

sentences.zh: 詔樞密措畫。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Bureau of Military Affairs to plan the matter.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Bureau of Military Affairs to arrange it.

sentences.zh: 三月乙卯，以將修太廟，遣李革奏告祖宗神主於明俊殿。

translations.literal: Third month, yimao: because the Imperial Ancestral Temple was to be repaired, Li Ge was sent to report to the ancestral spirit tablets at Mingjun Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on yimao, with the ancestral temple about to be repaired, Li Ge was sent to report to the spirit tablets at Mingjun Hall.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，曲赦中都、河北等路。

translations.literal: On dingsi a partial amnesty was granted in the Central Capital and Hebei circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi a partial amnesty was granted in the Central Capital and Hebei circuits.

sentences.zh: 議軍戶給地事。

translations.literal: The matter of granting land to military households was discussed.
translations.idiomatic: The court discussed granting land to military households.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，延州刺史溫撒可喜上疏言：「皇太子宜選正人為師保。

translations.literal: On yichou Yan Prefecture Prefect Wensake Kehan memorialized, saying: "The crown prince ought to have upright men chosen as tutors and protectors.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Yan Prefecture Prefect Wensake Kehan memorialized, "The crown prince should have upright men appointed as tutors and protectors."

sentences.zh: 」丙寅，長春節，宋遣使來賀。

translations.literal: " On bingyin, the Long Spring Festival; Song sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin was the Long Spring Festival; Song sent envoys with congratulations.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以將修社稷，遣太子少保張行信預告。

translations.literal: On jisi, because the Altar of Soil and Grain was to be repaired, Junior Tutor of the Heir Zhang Xingxin was sent to announce it in advance.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, with the Altar of Soil and Grain to be repaired, Junior Tutor of the Heir Zhang Xingxin was sent to announce the rites in advance.

sentences.zh: 滄州經略副使張文破趙福，復恩州。

translations.literal: Cangzhou Circuit Pacification Vice Commissioner Zhang Wen defeated Zhao Fu and recovered En Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Cangzhou Pacification Vice Commissioner Zhang Wen defeated Zhao Fu and recovered En Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丙子，曲赦遼東路。

translations.literal: On bingzi a partial amnesty was granted in the Liaodong circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi a partial amnesty was granted in the Liaodong circuit.

sentences.zh: 己卯，處士王澮以右諫議大夫復遷中奉大夫、翰林學士，仍賜詔褒諭。

translations.literal: On jimao the recluse Wang Huan was again promoted from Right Reminder to Palace Attendant and Hanlin Academician, and an edict of praise and instruction was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao recluse Wang Huan was again promoted from Right Reminder to Palace Attendant and Hanlin Academician, with an edict of praise.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，復邢州捷至。

translations.literal: On gengchen news of Xing Prefecture's recovery arrived.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen word arrived that Xing Prefecture had been recovered.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己丑，陝西行省來報秦州官軍破妖賊趙用、劉高二之捷。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, jichou: the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat reported victory of Qin Prefecture government troops over the demonic bandits Zhao Yong and Liu Gao'er.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on jichou, Shaanxi reported that Qin Prefecture troops had defeated the sorcerer-rebels Zhao Yong and Liu Gao'er.

sentences.zh: 遣官鞫單州防禦使僕散倬之罪，罷其城單州之役。

translations.literal: Officials were sent to try Defense Commissioner of Shan Prefecture Pusan Zhuo; the work of fortifying Shan Prefecture was halted.
translations.idiomatic: Officials were sent to try Shan Prefecture Defense Commissioner Pusan Zhuo, and work on fortifying Shan Prefecture was stopped.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，張開奏復清州等十有一城，詔遷官兩階，賞將士有差。

translations.literal: On guisi Zhang Kai memorialized the recovery of Qing Prefecture and eleven other cities; an edict advanced him two ranks and rewarded officers and soldiers variously.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Zhang Kai reported recovering Qing Prefecture and eleven other cities; an edict raised him two ranks and rewarded his officers and men at different levels.

sentences.zh: 甲午，改賜皇太子名守緒。

translations.literal: On jiawu the crown prince was granted the taboo name Shouxu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu the crown prince was given the taboo name Shouxu.

sentences.zh: 詔諭陝西路軍民。

translations.literal: An edict instructed the army and people of the Shaanxi circuit.
translations.idiomatic: An edict addressed the troops and people of the Shaanxi circuit.

sentences.zh: 丙申，河北行省侯摯言：「北商敗粟渡河，官遮糴其什八，商遂不行，民饑益甚。

translations.literal: On bingshen Hebei Branch Secretariat Hou Zhi said: "Northern merchants lost grain crossing the river; the government intercepted and purchased eight-tenths; merchants therefore would not travel, and the people's hunger grew worse.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Hebei Branch Secretariat Hou Zhi said, "Northern merchants lost grain crossing the river; officials seized eight-tenths for purchase; trade stalled and the people's famine worsened.

sentences.zh: 請罷其令。

translations.literal: We beg to abolish this order.
translations.idiomatic: We ask that this order be abolished."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 河南、陝西蝗。

translations.literal: Locusts in Henan and Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Locusts struck Henan and Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，太白晝見於奎。

translations.literal: On dingyou Venus appeared in daylight in Kui.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Venus was seen in daylight in the mansion of Kui.

sentences.zh: 己亥，夏人葩俄族都管汪三郎率其蕃戶來歸，以千羊進，詔納之，優給其直。

translations.literal: On jihai Wang Sanlang, chief of the Pa'e tribe of Xia, led his tribal households to submit, presenting a thousand sheep; an edict accepted them and generously paid the price.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Wang Sanlang, chief of the Xia Pa'e tribe, led his clansmen to submit with a gift of a thousand sheep; the court accepted them and paid generously.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，侯摯言：「紅襖賊掠臨沂、費縣之境，官軍敗之。

translations.literal: On xinchou Hou Zhi said: "Red-Robe bandits plundered the borders of Linyi and Fei counties; government troops defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Hou Zhi reported, "Red-Robe rebels raided Linyi and Fei; government troops beat them back.

sentences.zh: 獲其黨訊之，知其渠賊郝定僭號署官，已陷滕、兗、單諸州，萊蕪、新泰等十餘縣。

translations.literal: Capturing their followers and interrogating, they learned their chieftain-bandit Hao Ding had arrogated a title and appointed officials, having already taken Teng, Yan, Shan prefectures and more than ten counties such as Laiwu and Xintai.
translations.idiomatic: Prisoners revealed their leader Hao Ding had assumed a royal title, appointed officials, and seized Teng, Yan, Shan, and more than ten counties including Laiwu and Xintai.

sentences.zh: 」時道路不通，宰臣請諭摯為備。

translations.literal: " At the time roads were not open; the chief ministers asked that Zhi be instructed to prepare defenses.
translations.idiomatic: " With communications cut, the chief ministers asked that Zhi be warned to prepare defenses.

sentences.zh: 仍詔樞密招捕。

translations.literal: An edict also ordered the Bureau of Military Affairs to recruit and suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: An edict also ordered the Bureau of Military Affairs to recruit forces and suppress them.

sentences.zh: 蔡、息行元帥府兵拔木陡關，斬首千級。

translations.literal: Troops of the Cai-Xi Circuit Marshal Headquarters took Mudu Pass and beheaded a thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Troops of the Cai–Xi Circuit marshal headquarters seized Mudu Pass and took a thousand heads.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，有司言，扶風、郿縣有騑傷麥。

translations.literal: On jiachen the responsible office reported that in Fufeng and Mei counties auxiliary horses damaged the wheat.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen officials reported that in Fufeng and Mei auxiliary draft animals had trampled the wheat.

sentences.zh: 五月癸丑朔，禮官言：「太廟既成，行都禮雖簡約，惟以親行祔享為敬，請權不用鹵簿儀仗及宮縣樂舞。

translations.literal: Fifth month, guichou new moon — the Rites Office said: "The Imperial Ancestral Temple being completed, though capital rites are simplified, only personally performing the attendant enshrinement is reverence; we ask provisionally not to use halberd escorts, arms, and palace instrumental music and dance.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou new moon in the fifth month the Rites Office said, "With the ancestral temple finished, capital rites must stay spare but the emperor should enshrine the tablets in person; we ask to omit halberd guards, full regalia, and palace music for now.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 山東行省上沂州之捷。

translations.literal: The Shandong Branch Secretariat reported victory at Yi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Shandong Branch Secretariat reported a victory at Yi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，鳳翔之華、汝等州蝗。

translations.literal: On jiayin locusts in Hua, Ru, and other prefectures of Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin locusts afflicted Hua, Ru, and other prefectures in Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以尚書右丞侯摯行省事于東平。

translations.literal: On xinyou Right Vice Director of the Secretariat Hou Zhi conducted circuit affairs at Dongping.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Secretariat Right Vice Director Hou Zhi took up circuit duties at Dongping.

sentences.zh: 己巳，來遠鎮獲夏諜者陳絺等，知夏人將圖臨洮、鞏州，窺長安。

translations.literal: On jisi Laiyuan Garrison captured Xia spies Chen Qi and others, learning that Xia intended to strike Lintao and Gong Prefectures and spy on Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Laiyuan Garrison captured Xia spies including Chen Qi and learned Xia planned attacks on Lintao and Gong and reconnaissance toward Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 命陝西行省嚴為之備。

translations.literal: The Shaanxi Branch Secretariat was ordered to prepare defenses strictly.
translations.idiomatic: The Shaanxi Branch Secretariat was ordered to prepare strict defenses.

sentences.zh: 丙子，上將以七月行祔享禮，慮時雨有妨，詔改用十月。

translations.literal: On bingzi the emperor, intending to perform the attendant enshrinement rite in the seventh month, fearing seasonal rain would hinder it, ordered it moved to the tenth month.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi the emperor, planning attendant enshrinement in the seventh month, feared rain would interfere and moved the rite to the tenth month.

sentences.zh: 夏人修來羌城界河橋。

translations.literal: Xia repaired the border-river bridge at Lailiang Fortress.
translations.idiomatic: Xia repaired the border-river bridge at Lailiang Fortress.

sentences.zh: 元帥右都監完顏賽不遣兵焚之，俘馘甚多。

translations.literal: Marshal Right Director Wanyan Saibu sent troops to burn it and took many prisoners and heads.
translations.idiomatic: Marshal Right Director Wanyan Saibu sent troops to burn the bridge and took many prisoners and heads.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，京兆、同、華、鄧、裕、汝、亳、宿、泗等州蝗。

translations.literal: On wuyin locusts in Jingzhao, Tong, Hua, Deng, Yu, Ru, Bo, Su, and Si prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin locusts struck Jingzhao, Tong, Hua, Deng, Yu, Ru, Bo, Su, and Si.

sentences.zh: 六月戊子，詔凡進奏帖及申尚書省、樞密院關應大事，私發視者絞，誤者減二等，制書應密者如之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, wuzi: an edict ordered that whoever privately opened and viewed memorial posts or reports to the Ministry of the Masters of Writing and Bureau of Military Affairs concerning major affairs should be strangled; if by mistake, two degrees reduced; secret edicts likewise.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on wuzi, an edict made private opening of memorial posts or major reports to the Secretariat or Bureau of Military Affairs a capital crime; mistaken opening was two degrees lighter; the same applied to confidential edicts.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，遼西偽瀛王張致遣完顏南合、張頑僧上表來歸。

translations.literal: On renchen the false Prince of Ying of Liaoxi, Zhang Zhi, sent Wanyan Nanhe and Zhang Wanseng with a submission to submit.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Zhang Zhi, the false Prince of Ying in Liaoxi, sent Wanyan Nanhe and Zhang Wanseng with a memorial of submission.

sentences.zh: 詔授致特進，行北京路元帥府事，兼本路宣撫使，南合同知北京兵馬總管府，頑僧同知廣寧府。

translations.literal: An edict appointed Zhi extraordinary promotion and acting Beijing Circuit marshalate affairs, concurrently Pacification Commissioner of the circuit; Nanhe associate commissioner of the Beijing Military and Civil General Headquarters; Wanseng associate commissioner of Guangning Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: An edict made Zhi extraordinary promotion and acting Beijing Circuit marshal, with concurrent circuit pacification; Nanhe associate commander of Beijing military headquarters; Wanseng associate commissioner of Guangning.

sentences.zh: 丙申，木星晝見於奎，百有一日乃伏。

translations.literal: On bingshen Jupiter appeared in daylight in Kui; after one hundred and one days it set.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Jupiter was seen in daylight in Kui and remained visible for 101 days.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，詔有司祈雨。

translations.literal: On guimao an edict ordered the responsible offices to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao an edict ordered officials to pray for rain.

sentences.zh: 丁未，河南大蝗傷稼，遣官分道捕之。

translations.literal: On dingwei great locusts in Henan damaged the crops; officials were sent by separate routes to capture them.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei severe locusts in Henan ruined the harvest; officials were dispatched on several routes to destroy them.

sentences.zh: 罷河北諸路宣撫司，更置經略司。

translations.literal: The Hebei circuit Pacification commissions were abolished and Circuit Commissions were established in their place.
translations.idiomatic: Hebei Pacification commissions were abolished and replaced with Circuit Commissions.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以旱，詔參知政事李革審決京師冤獄。

translations.literal: On renzi, because of drought, an edict ordered Participation Councillor Li Ge to review and decide wrongful capital cases.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, owing to drought, an edict ordered Participation Councillor Li Ge to review wrongful cases in the capital.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸丑朔，昭義軍節度使必蘭阿魯帶復威州及獲鹿縣。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, guichou new moon: Zhaoyi Army military governor Bilan Aludai recovered Weizhou and Huolu County.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the guichou new moon, Zhaoyi Army Military Governor Bilan Aludai retook Weizhou and Huolu County.

sentences.zh: 飛蝗過京師。

translations.literal: Flying locusts passed over the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Locust swarms passed over the capital.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，山東行省檻賊郝定等至京師，伏誅。

translations.literal: On jiayin the Shandong Branch Secretariat's caged bandit Hao Ding and others reached the capital and were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Hao Ding and other caged rebels of the Shandong Branch Secretariat reached the capital and were put to death.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以旱蝗，詔中外。

translations.literal: On yimao, because of drought and locusts, an edict was issued to the court and realm.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, owing to drought and locusts, an edict went out to the court and the realm.

sentences.zh: 己未，敕減尚食數品及後宮歲給縑帛有差。

translations.literal: On jiwei an edict reduced by graded amounts the varieties of imperial cuisine and the annual silk allotments of the inner palaces.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei an edict cut, by graded amounts, the varieties of imperial cuisine and the inner palaces' annual silk allotments.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，監察御史陳規上章條陳八事。

translations.literal: On xinyou Supervising Censor Chen Gui submitted a memorial setting forth eight items.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Supervising Censor Chen Gui memorialized with eight proposals.

sentences.zh: 閏月壬午朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, renwu new moon: there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on the renwu new moon, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，復深州。

translations.literal: On xinmao Shenzhou was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Shenzhou was retaken.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，翰林學士完顏孛迭進《中興事蹟》。

translations.literal: On guisi Hanlin Academician Wanyan Biedie presented Records of the Restoration.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Hanlin Academician Wanyan Biedie presented Records of the Restoration.

sentences.zh: 甲午，命掌軍官舉奇才絕力之人，提控、都副統等官互舉其屬。

translations.literal: On jiawu the emperor ordered army command officers to recommend men of exceptional talent and extraordinary strength; supervisory controllers, deputy commanders-in-chief, and the like were to recommend their subordinates to one another.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu the emperor ordered army officers to recommend men of rare talent and exceptional strength; supervisory controllers, deputy commanders-in-chief, and the like were to cross-nominate within their commands.

sentences.zh: 頒舉官賞罰格，許功過相除。

translations.literal: Regulations for rewards and punishments in recommendation were promulgated, permitting merits and demerits to offset each other.
translations.idiomatic: Rules for rewards and punishments in nomination were issued, allowing merits and faults to cancel each other out.

sentences.zh: 品官及草澤人有才武者，舉薦升降亦如之。

translations.literal: Ranked officials and commoners of the marshes and wilds with martial talent were likewise to be nominated for promotion or demotion on the same terms.
translations.idiomatic: Ranked officials and talented commoners alike were to be recommended for promotion or demotion on the same terms.

sentences.zh: 庚子，詔河南、陝西鎮防軍應廕及納粟補官者，當役如舊，俟事定乃聽赴銓。

translations.literal: On gengzi an edict ordered that those in the garrison armies of Henan and Shaanxi who held yin privileges or had bought office with grain should serve as before; only when affairs were settled might they proceed to regular appointment review.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi an edict ruled that Henan and Shaanxi garrison troops holding yin privileges or offices bought with grain must still serve on duty; only after affairs settled might they go to regular appointment review.

sentences.zh: 八月甲寅，太子少保兼禮部尚書張行信定祔享親祀之儀以進。

translations.literal: On jiayin, eighth month, Crown Prince Junior Tutor and concurrent Minister of Rites Zhang Xingxin fixed the rites for associated enshrinement with the emperor's personal sacrifice and submitted them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, in the eighth month, Crown Prince Junior Tutor and concurrent Minister of Rites Zhang Xingxin set the rites for associated enshrinement at the emperor's personal sacrifice and submitted them.

sentences.zh: 上嘉納之。

translations.literal: The emperor commended and accepted them.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised and adopted them.

sentences.zh: 三原縣僧廣惠進僧道納粟多寡與都副威儀及監寺等格，從其言鬻之。

translations.literal: Guanghui, a monk of Sanyuan County, submitted scales for how much grain Buddhist and Taoist clergy should pay to purchase offices and for the insignia and robes of commanders and deputy commanders and the regulations for supervising temples; [the court] followed his proposal and sold [offices] accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: Guanghui, a monk of Sanyuan County, proposed scales for grain payments by clergy buying office, for commanders' and deputies' insignia and robes, and for temple supervisors; the court adopted his plan and sold offices accordingly.

sentences.zh: 夏人入安塞堡，元帥左監軍烏古論慶壽遣軍敗之。

translations.literal: Xia entered An'ai Fortress; Marshal Left Overseer Wugulun Qingshou sent troops and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Xia raided An'ai Fortress; Marshal Left Overseer Wugulun Qingshou sent troops and routed them.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，賜張行信寶券二萬貫、重幣十端，旌其議禮之當。

translations.literal: On renxu Zhang Xingxin was granted twenty thousand strings in treasury notes and ten bolts of heavy silks, honoring the correctness of his ritual proposals.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Zhang Xingxin received twenty thousand strings in treasury notes and ten bolts of heavy silks in recognition of his sound ritual advice.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，詔論中都民，命大名招撫使募人持詔以往。

translations.literal: On yihai an edict addressed the people of the Central Capital; the Daming Pacification Commissioner was ordered to recruit men to carry the edict there.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai an edict was addressed to the people of the Central Capital, and the Daming Pacification Commissioner was told to recruit men to carry it there.

sentences.zh: 丙子，大元兵攻延安。

translations.literal: On bingzi Great Yuan troops attacked Yan'an.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Great Yuan forces attacked Yan'an.

sentences.zh: 己卯，夏人入結耶觜川，官軍擊走之。

translations.literal: On jimao Xia entered Jieyezui River; government troops attacked and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Xia raided Jieyezui River; government forces beat them back.

sentences.zh: 九月辛巳朔，大元兵攻坊州。

translations.literal: Ninth month, xinsi new moon: Great Yuan troops attacked Fangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the xinsi new moon, Great Yuan forces attacked Fangzhou.

sentences.zh: 以簽樞密院事永錫為御史大夫，領兵赴陝西，便宜從事。

translations.literal: Signing Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs Yongxi was made censor-in-chief, led troops to Shaanxi, and was granted discretionary authority.
translations.idiomatic: Signing Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs Yongxi became censor-in-chief, took troops to Shaanxi, and was empowered to act at discretion.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，大元兵攻代州。

translations.literal: On renchen Great Yuan troops attacked Daizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Great Yuan forces attacked Daizhou.

sentences.zh: 經略使奧屯醜和尚戰沒。

translations.literal: Pacification Commissioner Aotun Chouheshang died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Pacification Commissioner Aotun Chouheshang was killed in action.

sentences.zh: 以中衛尉完顏奴婢等充賀宋生日使。

translations.literal: Central Guard Commandant Wanyan Nubi and others were made Song birthday envoys.
translations.idiomatic: Central Guard Commandant Wanyan Nubi and others were sent as Song birthday envoys.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己未，親王、百官奉迎祖宗神主於太廟。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on jiwei princes and the hundred officials escorted the ancestral spirit tablets into the Imperial Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month, on jiwei, princes and the hundred officials escorted the ancestral spirit tablets into the Imperial Temple.

sentences.zh: 招射生獵戶練習武藝知山徑者分屯陝、虢要地。

translations.literal: Archers and hunting households skilled in martial arts and knowing mountain paths were recruited and stationed at key points in Shaan and Guo.
translations.idiomatic: Bowmen and hunting households trained in martial arts who knew mountain tracks were recruited and posted at strategic points in Shaan and Guo.

sentences.zh: 命元帥左監軍必蘭魯帶守潼關，遙授知歸德府事完顏仲元軍盧氏。

translations.literal: Marshal Left Overseer Bilan Ludai was ordered to hold Tong Pass; Wanyan Zhongyuan was remotely appointed to Guide Prefecture affairs, with his army at Lushi.
translations.idiomatic: Marshal Left Overseer Bilan Ludai was ordered to defend Tong Pass; Wanyan Zhongyuan was given titular charge of Guide Prefecture while keeping his army at Lushi.

sentences.zh: 大元兵攻潼關，西安軍節度使泥旁古蒲魯虎戰沒。

translations.literal: Great Yuan troops attacked Tong Pass; Xi'an Army Military Governor Nipanggu Puluhu died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Great Yuan forces attacked Tong Pass; Xi'an Army Military Governor Nipanggu Puluhu fell in the fighting.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，上親行祔享禮。

translations.literal: On xinyou the emperor personally performed the associated-enshrinement rite.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou the emperor performed the associated-enshrinement rite in person.

sentences.zh: 甲子，祔享禮成。

translations.literal: On jiazi the associated-enshrinement rite was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the associated-enshrinement rite was completed.

sentences.zh: 赦。

translations.literal: Amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: An amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，詔諭河南官吏軍民，以賞格募立功之士。

translations.literal: On yichou an edict addressed Henan officials, soldiers, and people, recruiting men who would earn merit under the reward regulations.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou an edict called on Henan officials, troops, and civilians to enlist men for merit under the published reward scale.

sentences.zh: 命參知政事徒單思忠提控鎮撫京師，移剌周剌阿不屯關、陝。

translations.literal: Participation Councillor Tushan Sizhong was ordered to supervise and pacify the capital; Yila Zhouci Abudun was sent to Tong and Shaan.
translations.idiomatic: Participation Councillor Tushan Sizhong was put in charge of securing the capital; Yila Zhouci Abudun was sent to Tong and Shaan.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，詔京師具防城器械，多鑿坎熥，築垣牆於隙地。

translations.literal: On bingyin an edict ordered the capital furnished with defensive engines, many fire-pit trenches dug, and walls built on vacant ground.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin an edict ordered the capital stocked with siege gear, fire trenches dug in number, and walls thrown up on open ground.

sentences.zh: 徙衛紹及鎬厲王家屬于京師。

translations.literal: The households of the princes Wei Shao and Hao Liewang were moved to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The families of Princes Wei Shao and Hao Liewang were relocated to the capital.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以奉安社稷，遣官預告。

translations.literal: On dingmao, because the Altar of Soil and Grain was to be installed, officials were sent to announce it beforehand.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, with installation at the Altar of Soil and Grain impending, officers were sent to proclaim it in advance.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，命張行信攝太尉，奉安社稷，禮樂咸殺其數。

translations.literal: On wuchen Zhang Xingxin was ordered to act as Grand Master of Splendor, install the altar of soil and grain, and reduce the scale of ritual and music throughout.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Zhang Xingxin was commissioned acting Grand Master of Splendor to install the Altar of Soil and Grain, with ritual and music all scaled back.

sentences.zh: 詔吏、禮、兵、工四部尚書董防城之役。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the ministers of Personnel, Rites, War, and Works to oversee the work of city defense.
translations.idiomatic: An edict put the ministers of Personnel, Rites, War, and Works in charge of the capital's defenses.

sentences.zh: 大元兵徇汝州。

translations.literal: Great Yuan troops overran Ruzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Great Yuan forces overran Ruzhou.

sentences.zh: 己巳，沿河唯存通報小舟，餘皆焚之。

translations.literal: On jisi along the river only small dispatch boats were kept; the rest were burned.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi only small courier boats were left on the river; all others were burned.

sentences.zh: 庚午，詔宿糧州縣屯兵，其簽民為兵者就署隊長，以自防遏。

translations.literal: On gengwu an edict ordered grain-route prefectures and counties to station troops; drafted civilians made soldiers were to be appointed squad leaders on the spot for local defense.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu an edict ordered grain-route prefectures and counties to garrison troops; conscripted civilians were to be made squad leaders locally for self-defense.

sentences.zh: 河東行省胥鼎，遣潞州元帥左監軍必蘭阿魯帶以軍一萬，孟州經略使徒單百家以軍五千，由便道濟河趣關、陝，自將平陽精兵援京師。

translations.literal: Hedong Branch Secretariat Commissioner Xu Ding sent Bilan Aludai, marshal left overseer at Luzhou, with ten thousand troops, and Mengzhou Pacification Commissioner Tushan Baijia with five thousand, by convenient routes to cross the river and hurry to Tong and Shaan, while he himself led Pingyang's picked troops to relieve the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Hedong Branch Secretariat Commissioner Xu Ding sent Luzhou Marshal Left Overseer Bilan Aludai with ten thousand men and Mengzhou Pacification Commissioner Tushan Baijia with five thousand by the shortest routes across the river toward Tong and Shaan, while he himself led elite troops from Pingyang to relieve the capital.

sentences.zh: 命樞府督軍應之。

translations.literal: The Bureau of Military Affairs was ordered to supervise troops in response.
translations.idiomatic: The Bureau of Military Affairs was ordered to coordinate the responding armies.

sentences.zh: 辛未，置官領招賢所事。

translations.literal: On xinwei offices were established to head the talent-recruitment bureau.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei officers were appointed to run the talent-recruitment office.

sentences.zh: 命內外官探訪有才識勇略能區畫防城者具以聞，得實超任，仍賞舉主。

translations.literal: An edict ordered officials inside and outside the court to seek out men of talent, judgment, and courage who could plan city defense and report them fully; if verified they would be promoted beyond rank, and the recommender also rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: An edict told officials throughout the court and provinces to find able, bold planners of city defense and report them in full; the proven would be promoted beyond rank and the nominator rewarded as well.

sentences.zh: 內負長才不為人所知者，聽赴招賢所自陳。

translations.literal: Those within who bore great talent yet were unknown to others were permitted to present themselves at the talent-recruitment office.
translations.idiomatic: Talented men within the service who had gone unrecognized might present themselves at the talent-recruitment office.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以龍虎衛上將軍裴滿羊哥知歸德府事，行樞密院事。

translations.literal: On renshen Dragon-Tiger Guard Senior General Peiman Yangge was made in charge of Guide Prefecture affairs and acting commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Dragon-Tiger Guard Senior General Peiman Yangge was made acting prefect of Guide and acting Military Affairs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，詔罷遣有司所拘民間輸稅車牛以運軍士衣糧者。

translations.literal: On guiyou an edict ordered that the tax carts and oxen of the people that responsible offices had seized to transport soldiers' clothing and grain be released and sent back.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou an edict ordered offices to release civilian tax carts and oxen they had impressed to haul soldiers' clothing and grain.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，諭附京民盡徙其芻糧入城，官儲並運之。
