translations.literal: On jiaxu suburban residents attached to the capital were ordered to move all their fodder and grain into the city; official stores were transported in as well.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu residents of the capital suburbs were told to bring all fodder and grain inside the walls, and government stores were moved in as well.

sentences.zh: 丙子，行樞密院知河南府事完顏合打以徵兵失應，坐誅。

translations.literal: On bingzi Traveling Military Affairs Commissioner and Henan Prefect Wanyan Hedah was executed for failing to answer the levy call.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Traveling Military Affairs Commissioner and Henan Prefect Wanyan Hedah was put to death for failing to meet the levy.

sentences.zh: 戶部郎中魏琦以沒王事，官其子。

translations.literal: Section head Wei Qi of the Revenue Ministry, having died in the sovereign’s service, had his son given office.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Qi, section head in the Revenue Ministry, died in the sovereign’s service; his son was granted office.

sentences.zh: 己卯，議禁京師靡穀，近侍以寶券方行，恐滯其用，不果。

translations.literal: On jimao they debated banning wasteful grain use in the capital; attendants argued that treasury notes had only just been issued and might be held up — it was not carried out.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao the court debated banning profligate grain consumption in the capital, but attendants warned that treasury notes had only just been issued and might be choked off — and the ban was dropped.

sentences.zh: 吏部令史韓希祖陳言，曾以戰功致身者盡拘京師備用，從之。

translations.literal: Ministry of Personnel clerk Han Xizu memorialized that all who had risen by battle merit should be detained in the capital for reserve — approved.
translations.idiomatic: Han Xizu, a Ministry of Personnel clerk, proposed that every man who had won office through battle merit be held in the capital for reserve duty — and the court approved.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚辰朔，增定守禦官及軍人遷賞格。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, gengchen new moon: stipulations for defense officers and soldiers’ promotion and reward were increased.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the gengchen new moon, scales for promoting and rewarding defense officers and soldiers were revised upward.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，詔止附京農民自撤其廬舍。

translations.literal: On xinsi an edict forbade suburban farmers from demolishing their own huts.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi an edict forbade farmers near the capital from tearing down their own dwellings.

sentences.zh: 壬午，河東行省胥鼎入援京師，用其言以知平陽府王質權元帥左監軍，同知完顏僧家奴權右監軍，代鎮河東。

translations.literal: On renwu Hedong Branch Secretariat Xu Ding came to aid the capital; at his word Pingyang Prefect Wang Zhi was made acting Left Marshal Supervisor, Vice Commissioner Wanyan Sengjianu acting Right Marshal Supervisor, to hold Hedong in his stead.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Xu Ding of the Hedong Branch Secretariat marched to relieve the capital; on his advice Pingyang Prefect Wang Zhi was named acting left marshal supervisor and Vice Commissioner Wanyan Sengjianu acting right marshal supervisor to hold Hedong while Ding was away.

sentences.zh: 拜鼎為尚書左丞兼樞密副使，知歸德府完顏伯嘉簽樞密院事。

translations.literal: Ding was made Left Vice Director of the Secretariat and Military Affairs Vice Commissioner; Guidé Prefect Wanyan Bojia was assigned to sign Military Affairs Commission papers.
translations.idiomatic: Ding became Secretariat left vice director and Military Affairs vice commissioner; Guidé Prefect Wanyan Bojia was assigned to countersign Military Affairs papers.

sentences.zh: 以完顏合打伏誅，詔中外。

translations.literal: Because Wanyan Hedah had been executed, an edict announced it within and without.
translations.idiomatic: Because Wanyan Hedah had been executed, an edict announced the fact throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，元帥右都監完顏賽不來獻其提控石盞合喜、楊斡烈等大敗夏人於定西之捷，命行省視其功賞之。

translations.literal: On yiyou Marshal Right Director Wanyan Saibu came presenting the victory of his controllers Shizhan Hexi, Yang Wulie, and others, who had greatly defeated Xia at Dingxi; the branch secretariat was ordered to inspect merit and reward.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Marshal Right Director Wanyan Saibu arrived with news that his controllers Shizhan Hexi, Yang Wulie, and others had routed the Xia at Dingxi; the branch secretariat was told to verify merit and grant rewards.

sentences.zh: 大元兵至澠池，右副元帥蒲察阿裏不孫軍潰而逃，失其所佩虎符。

translations.literal: Great Yuan troops reached Mianchi; Right Deputy Marshal Pucha Ali Bunsun’s army broke and fled, losing the tiger tally he wore.
translations.idiomatic: Great Yuan forces reached Mianchi; Right Deputy Marshal Pucha Ali Bunsun’s army collapsed and fled, and he lost his tiger tally.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，前臨潢府推官權元帥右監軍完顏合達率官軍老幼自北歸國，升鎮南軍節度使，進官三階。

translations.literal: On bingxu former Linhuang prefectural judge and acting Right Marshal Supervisor Wanyan Heda led officers, soldiers, and families back from the north; he was made Zhennan Army military commissioner and advanced three ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu former Linhuang prefectural judge and acting right marshal supervisor Wanyan Heda led officers, soldiers, and families home from the north; he was made Zhennan Army military commissioner and advanced three ranks.

sentences.zh: 詔出公帑綿絹付有司償所括民服以衣軍者。

translations.literal: An edict ordered public treasury silk and satin given to the responsible offices to repay civilians whose clothing had been seized to clothe the army.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered silk from the public treasury paid to offices to compensate civilians whose garments had been seized for army clothing.

sentences.zh: 是夕，月暈木星，木在奎，月在壁。

translations.literal: That evening the moon haloed Jupiter; Jupiter was in Kui and the moon in Bi.
translations.idiomatic: That night the moon haloed Jupiter; Jupiter stood in Kui and the moon in Bi.

sentences.zh: 己丑，定毀防城器具法。

translations.literal: On jichou regulations on destroying siege-defense equipment were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou penalties for destroying siege-defense gear were set.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，詔立功五品以上官賜饌御前，六品以下官賜饌近侍局。

translations.literal: On xinmao an edict ordered that officials of fifth rank and above who won merit receive banquets before the throne, and those of sixth rank and below receive banquets from the Palace Attendants Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao an edict granted banquets before the throne to meritorious officials of fifth rank and above, and banquets from the Palace Attendants Bureau to those of sixth rank and below.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，上諭皇太子：「京城提控官有以文資充者，彼豈知兵？

translations.literal: On guisi the emperor told the crown prince: "Among the capital’s defense controllers are men holding civil appointments — how would they know war?
translations.idiomatic: On guisi the emperor told the crown prince, "Some of the capital’s defense controllers hold civil appointments — what do they know of war?

sentences.zh: 其速易之。

translations.literal: Replace them quickly."
translations.idiomatic: Replace them at once."

sentences.zh: 」甲午，放免諸職官傔從及諸司局射糧兵卒嘗選充軍者。

translations.literal: On jiawu officials’ attendants and marksmen-ration soldiers of the various bureaus who had once been drafted into the army were released.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu attendants of officials and bureau marksmen on ration who had once been drafted into the army were released.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，敕諸州縣簽籍軍民，以備土寇。

translations.literal: On wuxu an order commanded all prefectures and counties to register troops and civilians against local bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu an order commanded every prefecture and county to register soldiers and civilians against local bandits.

sentences.zh: 華州元帥府復潼關。

translations.literal: The Huazhou Marshalate recovered Tong Pass.
translations.idiomatic: The Huazhou marshalate recovered Tong Pass.

sentences.zh: 庚子，罷在京防城民軍。

translations.literal: On gengzi the capital’s civilian defense army was disbanded.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi the civilian defense force in the capital was disbanded.

sentences.zh: 遣御史陳規等充河南宣差安撫捕盜官。

translations.literal: Censor Chen Gui and others were sent as Henan special envoys for pacification and bandit suppression.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Gui the censor and others were dispatched as Henan special envoys to pacify the region and hunt bandits.

sentences.zh: 河南路統軍使紇石烈掃合以發兵後期，坐誅。

translations.literal: Henan Circuit unified army commissioner Heshenilie Saoge was executed for dispatching troops late.
translations.idiomatic: Heshenilie Saoge, Henan Circuit unified army commissioner, was put to death for late troop dispatch.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以尚書工部侍郎和尚等充賀宋正旦使。

translations.literal: On jiachen Minister of Works Vice Director Heshang and others were made envoys to congratulate Song on New Year’s Day.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Works Vice Director Heshang and others were sent as envoys to congratulate Song on the new year.

sentences.zh: 丙午，河南行樞密院從坦言，其族人道哥願隸行伍以自效。

translations.literal: On bingwu Henan Traveling Military Affairs Commissioner Congtan reported that his clansman Daoge wished to enlist for service.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Congtan, Henan traveling Military Affairs commissioner, reported that his clansman Daoge wished to join the ranks and serve.

sentences.zh: 上嘉其忠，許之。

translations.literal: The emperor praised his loyalty and approved.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised his loyalty and granted the request.

sentences.zh: 內族承立進所獲馬駝。

translations.literal: Imperial clansman Chengli presented captured horses and camels.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial clansman Chengli presented horses and camels taken in campaign.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「此軍士所得，即以予之可也，朕安用哉。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "These are the soldiers’ gains — give them directly; what use have I for them?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "These belong to the soldiers — give them back; what use are they to me?

sentences.zh: 」因遍諭諸道將帥，後勿復如是。

translations.literal: " He then instructed all route generals never to do so again.
translations.idiomatic: " He then told every route commander never to do this again.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛亥，平章政事朮虎高琪加崇進、尚書右丞相。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, xinhai: Grand Councilor Shuhu Gaoqi was advanced to Chongjin and Right Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on xinhai, Grand Councilor Shuhu Gaoqi was advanced to Chongjin and made Secretariat right director.

sentences.zh: 參知政事李革罷。

translations.literal: Participation Councillor Li Ge was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Participation Councillor Li Ge was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，大元兵攻平陽。

translations.literal: On guihai Great Yuan troops attacked Pingyang.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Great Yuan forces attacked Pingyang.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，皇太子議伐西夏。

translations.literal: On bingyin the crown prince discussed attacking Western Xia.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin the crown prince debated an attack on Western Xia.

sentences.zh: 大元兵徇大名府。

translations.literal: Great Yuan troops overran Daming Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Great Yuan forces overran Daming Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 壬申，大元兵進自代州神仙橫城及平定承天鎮諸隘，攻太原府。

translations.literal: On renshen Great Yuan troops advanced from Daizhou through Immortal Pass, Hengcheng, and the Chengtian Fort barriers at Pingding to attack Taiyuan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Great Yuan forces advanced from Daizhou through Immortal Pass and Hengcheng and the Chengtian Fort passes at Pingding to strike Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 宣撫使烏古論禮遣人間道齎礬書至京師告急。

translations.literal: Pacification Commissioner Wugulun Li sent a man by a side path bearing alum-script letters to the capital to report the emergency.
translations.idiomatic: Pacification Commissioner Wugulun Li sent a courier by a hidden route with alum-script dispatches to the capital begging relief.

sentences.zh: 詔發潞州元帥府，平陽、河中、絳、孟宣撫司兵援之。

translations.literal: An edict mobilized the Luzhou Marshalate and the pacification armies of Pingyang, Hezhong, Jiang, and Meng to aid it.
translations.idiomatic: An edict mobilized the Luzhou marshalate and pacification forces from Pingyang, Hezhong, Jiang, and Meng to relieve the city.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，高琪請修南京裏城。

translations.literal: On yihai Gaoqi asked to repair Nanjing’s inner wall.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Gaoqi proposed repairing the inner wall of Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「民力已困，此役一興，病滋甚矣。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "The people’s strength is already spent; once this work begins, their affliction will worsen.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "The people are already exhausted; if this project starts, their suffering will only deepen.

sentences.zh: 城雖完固，朕亦何能獨安此乎？」

translations.literal: Though the walls stand firm, how could I alone be secure here?"
translations.idiomatic: Even if the walls are strong, how could I alone be safe here?"
